titles.JP: 豪華絢爛！ゴールデン・ベイ

sequence: 奢华！享梦！浮金湾！  阁下，该醒咯~

scripts.say: 阁下~阁下？该醒咯？
这般贪睡，可不是指挥官该有的仪态呢~
黑暗中，魅惑的低语声化作湿软的触感爬上我的耳畔，细细舔舐着我的耳朵。
我缓缓睁眼，迎上葛兹俯近的眼眸，她微凉的指尖抚上了我的颈侧，轻轻游移。
呵呵~您终于醒了，亲爱的阁下~
唔……您的脉搏跳得这么快，难不成是在主动邀请我“就餐”吗？
正巧我也已经饿了很久了呢，就请允许我……轻轻尝一口吧？
葛兹凑得更近，暧昧的鼻息蹭过脸颊……随后顿了顿，从那的眼眸中透露出一丝危险的信息。
……呵，竟敢打搅我的兴致。
话音未落，整个房间突然剧烈摇晃起来。
阁下~阁下？该醒咯？
这般贪睡，可不是指挥官该有的仪态呢~
在熟悉的话语声中，我的意识终于逐渐变得清明。
缓缓睁眼后，最先撞入眼底的，仍是那双俯近的眼眸。
这双眼眸不像刚才的梦境那般魅惑，而是多了些许从容。
您终于醒了呢，阁下~
她微凉的指尖依旧轻搭在我的颈侧，没有了方才的暧昧游移，只剩几分轻柔的安抚。
透过她身后的舷窗，我们本次航行的目的地终于初次露面——
无垠黄沙与蔚蓝大海之间，繁华的都市森林傲然矗立，显得奢丽非凡。
金色的城市近在咫尺……看来我们已经安全穿过风暴了呢。
刚刚抵达浮金湾附近空域的时候，我们的飞机遭遇了一场突如其来的风暴。
好在最后，我们有惊无险地冲出风暴，成功抵达浮金湾。
这场万众瞩目的度假，终于要正式拉开序幕了呢♪~
飞机平稳降落后，大家换乘车辆入住预定的酒店。
简单休息后，明石站在我的酒店套房内，向我们介绍起城市的情况。
喵~指挥官！欢迎来到浮金湾喵！
这里可是度假胜地中最最最豪华的那一档！而且气候舒适，风景绝美，还有超多好吃的好玩的喵！
尤其是咱们不远处的浮金大厦，可是这座城市的地标建筑喵！
确实很壮观，在阳光下熠熠生辉。
那当然喵~！这可是明石我千挑万选的度假地喵~！
浮金大厦上，还有一颗镶嵌在顶上的“浮金珍宝”！入夜后会发出璀璨的光芒，也是浮金湾的财富象……
象……象征……财富象征……换句话说……就是昂贵到把明石卖了都不一定买得起……
所以这这这是怎么回事喵？！“浮金珍宝”不见了喵？！！
那么大一颗镶嵌在顶部、能折射阳光的宝石，怎么会凭空消失了喵？！！
顺着明石的目光望去，浮金大厦的顶端果然并无任何装饰。
喵——！！明石的保证金！！
我之前为了租下这座城市的专属度假权，付了超大额的保证金喵！！！
条款里写得清清楚楚，如果城市里的重要物品损坏或者丢失，就要支付巨额赔偿喵！！

options.content: 可以
我有个长远之计……

scripts.say: 呜喵……如果保证金收不回来……那指挥官作为明石的合伙人，可以……分点利润给我喵？！
可以是可以，但我们还需要准备一条长远之计。
我们可以在试营业期间完善好相关服务，这样正式开业后就不用担心利润了。
比起这样，我还有个长远之计划。
我们可以在试营业期间完善好相关服务，这样正式开业后就不用担心利润了。
而且，宝石也不会自己长出脚来逃走。既然我们已经包下了浮金湾，就有时间展开搜查。
指挥官说得有道理，完全把明石说服了喵……虽然很想这么说！
又要想办法找宝石，又要提升服务质量，明明是假期，为什么最忙碌的却是我喵~！！

sequence: 奢华！享梦！浮金湾！  为你献上的礼物

scripts.say: 夜晚，我依约来到海岸。海风吹拂着脸颊，远处的海面泛着细碎的月光。
而那片波光里，一道身影正随着波浪缓缓起伏，宛如一枚随波漂流、散发着微光的水母。
……指挥官……请到这边来……
我涉水向她走去。
U-2501正仰面漂在海水中，长发在水中散开，眼眸在月光下倒映着星辰。
为您准备的直升机……已经在待命了哦……
指挥官，现在就可以出发了呢。
去到高高的天空上……欣赏……大家一起为您悄悄筹备了好多天的……惊喜~
为了保密，才特地用这个方式……约您出来……
她的声音渐渐低了下去，但藏在其中的羞涩和喜悦却清晰可闻。
不过……我其实，很开心。
能像这样……和您独处一会儿，哪怕只有片刻，也觉得很满足，很开心……嘿嘿~
夜潜装备，已经穿戴好了……
我们也……准备出发了~
希望……您能喜欢……嘿嘿~♪
她将脸颊轻轻贴在我肩头蹭了蹭，留下微凉湿润的触感。
下一秒便宛如熟知水性的鱼儿，从我怀中灵巧而安静地滑入水中。
轰鸣声中，直升机拔地而起。我透过舷窗，俯视着下方那片无垠的幽蓝。
海面平静如墨色的绸缎。忽然——
一点粉色的光，在深邃的墨蓝中悄然亮起。
紧接着，第二点，第三点……无数光点次第浮现，无声地绽放着，如同落入海中的璀璨群星。
光点摇曳着，移动着，慢慢在海面上编织出巨大的爱心形状——
大家~该就位了哦~
安克雷奇……准备，完毕！
scripts.actorName: 安克雷奇 [海豚、海洋、游泳课]

scripts.say: 呼~赶上了~
等、等一下，哈曼还没——借过借过！
scripts.actorName: 哈曼II [再一次(?)的夏日战争]

scripts.say: 说起来，大家是不是忘了关通讯器啊？！慌慌张张的准备阶段也让指挥官听到了——
这样不也挺好嘛~说不定，能让指挥官更期待接下来会发生什么哦？
唔……一会儿该用什么样的动作幅度，挥舞爱心灯来着……？
scripts.actorName: 伴尔维 [清凉的甜蜜滋味]

scripts.say: 我的话，会拿出参加摇滚音乐会的气势哦。
那我可不能输给你呢。
scripts.actorName: 雷根斯堡 [暗之龙，光之岸]

scripts.say: 通讯器里，一道道熟悉的声音接连响起。
海面上那起初略显单薄的轮廓，渐渐被不断汇入的暖光温柔填满——
这就是大家对指挥官的爱吗……身处人群之中，好像也能更清晰地感受到了。
哥哥平时总是关照着我们……所、所以这次，我们也想好好回应哥哥的心意……！
好啦~各位——让我们有节奏地挥舞手中的爱心灯，将我们为亲爱的准备的惊喜，亲手奉上吧！
倒计时！3——

scripts.actorName: 安妮女王复仇号 [隐秘之拥的呼唤]
冒险号 [多疑领主的晚宴]

scripts.say: 海面上，那颗巨大的“爱心”缓缓跳动起来。
欸欸欸~指挥官能看到了吗？
这在海面之上跳动的爱心——这就是我们对你的心意哦。
只愿被您知晓……只愿被您接受……
scripts.actorName: 加斯科涅 [夏季环境应对外装]

scripts.say: 热乎乎、湿漉漉的满腔爱意♡~
scripts.actorName: 莫加多尔 [静谧一隅的燥热]

scripts.say: 谢谢您……带我们一起度过了一个，完美的假期……
这就是……大家为你准备的，最特别的度假礼物~♪

sequence: ——「奢华！享梦！浮金湾！」·FUN
奢华！享梦！浮金湾！  云端的水光

scripts.say: 指、指挥官……你来了……！
收到雅努斯的邀约，我来到了这处位于穹顶酒店顶层的泳池，午后的风掠过云端，掀起池水细微的涟漪。
雅努斯并没有如想象中那样在水中嬉戏，而是蜷在一旁的躺椅上，紧紧搂着一只靠枕，目光怯怯地望向泳池边缘——
那里与天空几乎相接，栏杆外便是绵延至远方的海岸线与繁华的城市。
这里的视野很开阔呢。雅努斯，要一起看看吗？
……呜，那、那个……
雅努斯的身躯轻轻颤了一下，非但没有起身，反而将脸埋进枕中，声音闷闷地传来。
对、对不起……其实从刚才开始，雅努斯就一直不敢从躺椅上坐起来……
风好大……一松开枕头，雅努斯就感觉要被吹飞了……
对不起，指挥官……！
明明是雅努斯邀请指挥官来的……却连走到水边都做不到……
一边说着，雅努斯更深地把头埋在枕头里，抓着枕头的手抓得更紧了。
没关系的，雅努斯。
我在她身旁坐下，轻轻覆上她微凉的手背。
她的掌心渗出细密的汗，身体止不住地发抖，像一只受惊的小猫。
别担心，有我抓住你，你不会有危险的。
我慢慢将她五指收拢，握入掌心。另一只手抚过她的额发，为她拭去汗珠。
雅努斯身体仍有些僵硬，却乖巧地任由我引导，只是睫毛不时轻颤。
闭上眼睛，雅努斯。只感受风的声音，和我手心的温度就好。
嗯……指挥官的手，好温暖……
来，跟着我一起深呼吸——吸气……慢慢吐气……
一边引导着雅努斯，一边轻揉她紧绷的肩膀，时不时感受到透过肌肤传来的阵阵轻颤。
好在没过多久，她的颤抖就随着一次次深呼吸渐渐平息，指尖也不再冰凉，反而生出令人安心的暖意。
呼……雅努斯好像……没有那么害怕了……
要不要试着，慢慢地在水池边走走？
不想睁开眼睛也没关系，我会一直牵着你。
好的……我相信指挥官……！
我牵引着雅努斯缓缓起身，向着泳池走去，每一步都踏得极轻，仿佛行走在云朵之上。
风依旧拂动着她的发丝，雅努斯没有退缩，只是更紧地握住我的手。
来到池边时，我先踏入水中，转身朝她伸出双臂。
接下来，我会松开手——但只有一瞬间。别怕，我就在你身前。
好的……雅努斯，不害怕……雅努斯，可以做到的……
只要有指挥官在身边，雅努斯，就能够得到勇气……！
雅努斯深吸一口气，身体向前轻轻倾倒——她落入池中，水花轻柔地绽开，我将她稳稳地拥入怀中。
云朵……就在手边呢！还有远处的海，亮晶晶的……雅努斯真的……做到了……！
她将脸轻靠在我的肩头，声音柔软得像拂过水面的风。
能和指挥官一起，欣赏这么美的景色，雅努斯，真的很开心……！所以……
指挥官，可以就这样，和雅努斯多待一会吗……？一会会，就好……
水波荡漾之间，她的笑声轻轻响起，漾开一圈圈细微而幸福的涟漪。

sequence: 奢华！享梦！浮金湾！  直至心跳相融

scripts.say: 浮金大厦的顶端，巨大的旋翼轰鸣声回荡在空气中。
我走向那架敞开机舱的直升机，看到了早已等候在那里的莫加多尔。
指挥官……您终于来了呢……
我等这一刻，等得身体都在发烫了~♡
来吧，让我们一起迈向云端吧~
我握住她的手，借力登上摇晃的机舱后，直升机随即开始爬升。
舱门大开，强劲的气流毫无阻隔地掠过她大片的肌肤，带起阵阵冰冷的战栗。
然而她没有缩起身子，反而迎着风舒展了一下。
随后，她兴奋地回头望向我，脸上因刺激和期待泛着红潮。
呼——♡感觉到了吗，指挥官~
这风……哈啊……直接刮在皮肤上的感觉……
等我们跳下去之后，它就会变得更猛烈、更无情……
带走脑海里所有多余的思绪……只留下最纯粹的……刺激……♡
而且，您知道吗~？被失重感抓住的时候……整个世界……都会颠倒过来哦~
听起来很奇妙。
不止是奇妙哦~
我们除了彼此……没有任何依靠，只能和指挥官一起不断下坠……
那种把一切都交给指挥官的感觉……
哈啊……光是想象，我就……♡
她的呼吸变得急促，脸颊绯红，紧紧盯着我的眼睛。
嘿嘿……和我一起跳下去吧……指挥官？
让狂风撕扯我们，让天空吞噬我们……
在落入云朵之前，谁也别想分开我们♡
……听起来更要注意安全了呢。
呼哈……对莫加多尔来说……最危险的，是指挥官你哦~♡
您看……我现在坐在这里，心跳快得不行，身上又热又湿……
这都是因为您在我身边呢……♡
就在此时，机舱内响起一声清晰的电子提示音——
那是到达预定跳伞高度的信号。
啊……这个声音……终于等到了……♡
我的身体，我的心跳……都在期待着这一刻呢~♡
她湿漉漉的手指，钻进了我的指缝中。
随后侧过身，湿热的吐息喷洒在我颈侧。她近乎渴求地埋首嗅着什么。
呼——哈♡要好好记住指挥官的气味才行呢……♡
现在……指挥官，不要看下方……要看着我……只看着我哦……♡
然后……和我一起坠落吧——
直到我们的心跳……都融为一体……♡
没有犹豫，我们向后微微倾身——
失重感攫住整个身躯，直升机急速缩小，震耳的风声瞬间灌满了一切。
呀啊——！！！来了，终于来了——！！
指挥官——这滋味美妙吗♡——！！
我无法张口，只能更用力地回抱她作为回答。
我们相拥着向下坠去，试图扯开我们的狂风反而让我们贴得更密不可分。
啊哈——抱得更紧了——我好开心——♡！！
汗一下就被吹干了——但贴着您的地方……哈啊……烫得我要融化了——♡
听不清——？那我再说一遍——！
指挥官——现在您眼里……满满的都是我了对吧——！
哈啊——虽然气味被吹散了——但没关系！您已经——在我里面了——
她忽然伸出手，用力按住了我的后脑，让我们的额头紧紧相贴。
看到了吗——我的眼睛里……只烙着您哦♡
云朵——我们要掉进去了——抱紧我——在里面——会更紧地抱紧我吧——♡
刹那间，世界变成一片潮湿的、翻滚的纯白，风声骤变，周身被冰凉柔软的雾气包裹。
尽管在云中看不清周围，但其他感官却被无限地放大。
滚烫的体温透过紧贴的肌肤传来，剧烈得让我们分不清彼此心跳。以及——
那近在咫尺的、混杂着兴奋的喘息声。
躲进这里——谁也看不到我们了——
只有我们——在一直下坠着——
嘻嘻——直到坠落至尽头之前……全都是……我们的时间了哦♡

sequence: 奢华！享梦！浮金湾！  蜜渍余甘

scripts.say: 将派对的喧嚣关在门外，我走进休息室，发现路易九世正侧躺在房间中央的圆桌上。
她的肌肤因醉后微醺透出淡红，罕见地毫无防备，手边是一小罐打翻了的金色桔子酱。
唔……头有点沉……
……指挥官？
非常抱歉，我……只记得想找个安静的地方醒醒神……碰巧，这里看起来合适……
她的反应有些迟缓，听到我带来的动静后才微微抬起头，露出沾上果酱的肌肤。
啊……这是……
这个果酱……闻起来很清新，有点酸酸的味道。
据说，尝一点酸味，对驱散醉意有帮助……
这样才能，才能继续清醒着履行守护您的职责……
她一边说，一边用手指漫无目的地划拉着皮肤上的果酱，牵出一缕缕金黄蜜泽。
尝了果酱之后……又觉得身上很热……
就想到，涂上这些或许能舒服点……
她的指尖无意识蹭过唇角，随即看着自己黏糊糊的手指。
随后轻轻蹙起眉，流露出一种孩子气的、无奈的困扰。
结果……就变成您看到的这样样子。
……嗯？指挥官，您的手……？
忽然，她朦胧的视线落在了我扶在桌沿的手上——那里也不慎沾上了一抹金黄。
……是什么时候沾上的……
失礼了，请允许我来帮您清理干净……
她伸出手，有些执拗地握住了我的手腕，醉意让她的力道失了往日的分寸。
带着醉后特有的、不容分说的专注，她低下头……
……温软的触感伴随着细微湿润的暖意，快速而轻柔地掠过我的指尖。
还有这里……也弄脏了……
这样就干净了……
几乎是在完成这番动作的同时，她微微愣了一些，握着我手腕的指尖无意识收紧。
她极其缓慢地、一点点地抬起头，那双总是沉静如红酒的眼眸骤然瞪大，写满慌乱和羞耻。
红晕以肉眼可见的速度，从她的颈项漫上耳尖，再彻底席卷脸颊。
我……我刚才——！
她慌乱地试图从桌上起身，手臂却一软，碰倒了桌边的酒瓶，发出一阵响动。
非常抱歉！指挥官！我竟做出如此……如此失仪之举！
这绝非骑士应有的行为，请您……务必施予惩戒！
冷静点。你只是醉了。至于惩罚……
就罚你陪我一起继续收拾干净桌面吧。
……我明白了！路易九世，定当不负所托。

sequence: 奢华！享梦！浮金湾！  水幕画心

scripts.say: 房间内，一道半透明的水幕如帘般垂落，U-2501的歌声从水幕后断断续续地传来。
U-2501，你在里面么？
门被我推开时，水幕后的身影稍稍顿住，随后害羞地往旁边挪了挪，似乎想把自己藏进水幕之后。
啊……抱、抱歉……我……我没有听到你敲门的声音……

options.content: 或许……
我能理解

scripts.say: 应该……是被水流声盖住了……
或许还有你的歌声？
我能理解，唱歌时是很难注意到周围的声音。
欸……指挥官……您、您都听到了么……
短暂沉默后，她的手指小心翼翼地穿过水幕伸向我，似乎是希望我凑近一些……
她拉过我的手，用指尖滑动勾勒出了一个表情……「*//▿//*」。
这是……在害羞么？
嗯……嘿嘿……
那我的心情就是……
我没让她把手收回去，而是轻轻握住她的手腕，在她掌心认真画下了另一个表情……「>w<」
很好听的旋律。能听到你的歌声，我很高兴。
唔……指挥官说……好听……
能被指挥官这么夸奖……我也……好高兴……
她眉眼弯弯地笑了，羞涩而柔和。
随后，像是终于鼓起了勇气，她轻轻牵引着我的手，带我越过了那道水幕。
几次呼吸调整后，极轻极缓的哼唱声再次响起。
似乎是想传达地更为清晰一些，她将我的手掌展开，轻柔地覆在她微微颤动的喉间。
温柔的旋律越过水幕，化作清晰的悸动，流淌进了我心底。
指挥官喜欢的话……我可以……每天都唱给你您听……
不仅是歌声……连同我所有的声音……都只给您一个人听……
就像现在这样……
她引导着我的手缓缓向下移动，划过精致的锁骨，抚过温热的肌肤，最终停留在她仅着泳衣的胸前。
我的心跳声……在这里……您能听到么……？
旋律和心跳……现在，同步了……都是为了指挥官，在跳动着……
她拿起放在一旁的防水录音笔，轻轻按下了录音键，然后将它放在了我们紧贴的掌心之间。
这一次……我想拥有“我们在一起”时的声音……发出的声音都留下来……
指挥官的呼吸……我的哼唱……还有我们重叠的心跳……
水幕依旧潺潺流淌，将我们笼罩在这个呼吸与呼吸、心跳与心跳相互重叠的小小世界里。
她不再说话，只是闭着眼，将额头轻轻抵在我的肩上，让那温柔的哼唱，继续如水流般绵延。

sequence: 奢华！享梦！浮金湾！  水畔的夕暮私语

scripts.say: 在夕阳的余晖中，忙碌了一天的我靠在泳池边缘，任由冰凉的池水包裹着身体。
然而下一瞬，身前的水面毫无征兆地划开，那熟悉的气息随之将我包围。
唇边噙着笑的埃姆登近在咫尺，水珠顺着她的发丝与脖颈滑落。
抓到你了哦，我可爱的人类……「你终究，是逃不掉的~」
独自一人沉浸在思绪里……是在享受这难得的孤独吗？
「真不乖呢，竟然试图抛下我们。」
她湿透的银发贴着白皙的肌肤与肩头，眼眸在暮光下闪烁着玩味的光芒。
未等我开口，她的手臂已环过我的腰际，将我轻轻拉向她的怀中。
埃姆登？你是从什么时候……
呵呵~从你踏入池水，将身心毫无防备地交给这方天地的那一刻起……
「我们……就一直在看着你呢~」
想独享宁静？这可不行……「你的所有时光，都理应由我们来定义~」
她的身体更紧地贴合上来，传来与池水截然不同的、令人心跳加速的体温。
呵呵呵……放松警惕，将自己如此甜美地呈现出来的人类……
「你心底，难道不是在渴望着被我们探寻、被据为己有吗？」
嘘……不用回答。
她伸手轻轻点在我的唇上，另一只手则没入水中，缓缓滑上我的脊背。
不必思考，只需感受水的流动就好……「对，就这样……让我们的节奏引导你的呼吸……」
此时此刻，水流的触感还很清晰吧？但很快……你就会忘记池水本身。
因为最终包裹你、牵引你知觉的……「将不再是它，而是我们哦。」
埃姆登……
在哦，一直都在。无论水中，还是……「更深处的地方……」
她的双腿若有似无地夹住了我的大腿，带来一阵细微的战栗。
「来吧，人类……看着我们。」好好看着，是谁在夺走你的呼吸，是谁在搅乱你的心跳。
然后，彻底沉醉其中吧。「把一切都交给我们来主导……」
环抱的力度悄然收紧，肌肤相贴之处，池水的温度似乎正逐渐攀升。
她的唇瓣贴上耳廓，呢喃伴随着温热的触感一同侵入。
很温暖吧？这份将你彻底包裹起来的感觉……「再也……无处可逃了呢。」
那么，要开始了哦？这趟通往更深处的……「这场仅容你我二人的航行……」
让我们听听……你那被水波掩盖的、加速的心跳声……
「让我们看看……你这被水光浸透的、再也无法移开的眼神……」
在她的话语声中，我的视线逐渐被她彻底占据，意识也随之沉溺于她轻柔的掌控之中。
来吧，我可爱的人类……「让我们一同……」
沉沦吧……「沉沦吧……」

sequence: 奢华！享梦！浮金湾！  赤红之月的幻想

scripts.say: 这个情景，就是为你量身定制的美梦……
喜欢吗，亲爱的阁下？
受葛兹·冯·伯利欣根邀请，我前往体验她说的体感VR。
再睁开眼，我已站在摩天大楼高层的玻璃幕墙前。
而玻璃的另一边，正是倒悬于红月之下的“魔鬼”——
她将整张手掌贴上玻璃，那条标志性的细长尾巴慵懒地叩击着玻璃，发出一声声轻响。
你似乎也乐在其中？
因为这里是能放下伪装，靠近您的地方。
她轻笑着，尾巴竟像穿过水面般，毫无阻碍地穿透了玻璃，灵活地探了进来。
那尾巴先是在我的面前划过，又在胸口处画了几个圆圈，最后卷上了我的手腕。
您看，界限已经开始模糊了……
阁下不妨来验证试试？
闻言，我抬起手试探着伸向玻璃，冰冷的触感在瞬间化为某种柔软的阻滞，仿佛探入温润的水体。
随后，指尖穿了过去，触到了她倒悬的脸颊。她的肌肤微凉，因我的触碰而轻轻一颤。
您碰到我了呢~
沿着她倒悬的面颊轮廓，滑向纤细的脖颈，最终停留在她裸露的锁骨窝。
与此同时，她的尾巴已悄然缠上我的腰肢，将我缓缓拉近。
这层玻璃真是又恼人，又美妙……
它让我能如此放肆地看您，又让我……无法真正品尝您。
她的另一条手臂也穿透进来，环住我的脖子，将我的头拉向她。
我们之间仅剩一层模糊的玻璃介质，呼吸在两侧蒸腾出白雾。
她将唇凑近，印在我唇的位置，我已能感受到那冰冷而魅惑的触感。
你无法打破它么？
仅凭我一人确实不行，但只要能获得您的允许……就能够做到了~
我知道的哦……阁下内心，是希望我这么做的，对吧？
仿佛回应她的话语，那层阻隔，也在我们紧贴的身体之间变得越来越薄。
随后，她的蝠翼用力一振，整个身体冲破阻隔，猛地向前扑来——
抓到您了~
她修长的双腿顺势环上我的腰，那条尾巴更是紧紧缠绕，将我们牢牢捆在一起。
蝠翼收拢，形成一个私密的空间。
亲爱的阁下~♪
想好要怎么款待我了吗？
她开始缓缓移动腰肢，借助环抱的力量，在我怀中上下轻磨。
我的手掌顺着她光滑的脊背下滑，指尖陷入那柔软的腰窝。
她的肌肤敏感发烫，每一次手指的摩擦都让她溢出细微的颤音。
对，就这样……
请您缓解我的饥渴……♪
脖颈一侧忽然传来轻微的刺痛感，她湿润的嘴唇贴在我的肌肤上，仿佛在吮吸着什么。
那是沉溺于欲望的咬噬，也是一个甜蜜又充满占有欲的标记。
直到我满足为止，都不可以结束哦~♡

sequence: 奢华！享梦！浮金湾！  碧波绮尾

scripts.say: 按照天城的邀请，我来到水族馆深处的展示区，看到了正在深水中翩然翻转的她。
那彩光白珠的鱼尾严密贴合着她的腰臀曲线，随水波漾开粼粼碎光。
我就知道主上一定会来的，呵呵~
这片幽蓝的水域，便是天城为您准备的，独一无二的舞台。
她舒展手臂向后仰去，鱼尾随着水流的托举缓缓绽开。
一个优雅的回旋后，她游至玻璃前，掌心贴上冰凉的幕墙，恰好与玻璃外侧我的手掌轮廓重合。
请暂且忘却岸上的烦忧……只沉浸于我，可好？
当然，若是主上愿意……这也可以成为，我们对彼此的演出呢。
她用指尖在玻璃上划出一道水痕，随即转身向侧面游去，长发如墨色海藻在身后迤逦散开。
我跟随她的方向走进准备间时，她已靠在池畔，正略带苦恼地看着自己那几条吸满水的尾巴。
真是遗憾，想要与主上一同下水，却无法亲自为主上更衣了呢……
作为补偿，水下的一切，都由我来引导主上的感知吧~
在她期待的目光中，我换上了潜水服钻入水中，略微适应了几秒后，她便缓缓游近。
她的手臂环上我的脖颈，鱼尾随之自然地缠绕上我的腰身。
待距离已经足够近了之后，她凑上脸颊，嘴唇张合的轮廓是那么轻柔。
呵呵~主上感觉到了吗？水流正把我们推得更近……
仿佛这片水域，也在期盼着我们相拥呢~
她引导着我的手，抚上她臀侧鱼尾的接合处，感受着仿鳞材质与她腰肢上裸露的肌肤，形成的奇妙对比。
这鱼尾做得很精细……就像真的一样。
因为它只为拥抱主上而生。主上……想感受它全部的柔软吗？
未等我回答，她已经开始缓慢地摆动鱼尾，每一次起伏都让我们的身体更紧密地摩擦。
主上……能听到我的心跳了吗？
它正在说……想要更近、更近地感受您。
呵呵，忘了呢，我们现在还在水下……那就……
她牵着我的右手，按在她胸口。我感受到那如薄纱般的水膜下的温热肌肤，以及急促的心跳。
我用左手揽住她的腰，她顺势让鱼尾完全缠绕住我的双腿，如同共生的双子般在水中交融，下沉……
她轻轻呼出一串晶莹的气泡，在我们相贴的脸颊旁盘旋、上升，抵达散开的长发处一同在水中绽开。
我们被气泡包围了呢……就像一个小小的，只属于我们的世界。
主上……想在这个世界里，留下更深的印记吗？
那纤细的手指抚上我的脸颊，指尖在水下显得格外柔软。
她的唇轻轻贴上我的唇角。不是亲吻，更像试探——柔软、湿润、带着微凉的水意。
吻从唇角移至颈侧，她轻轻吮吻着，留下转瞬即逝的酥麻感。
这就是……人鱼的吻……它会将您的气息留在我的血脉里……
她再度吻上来，同时引导着我的手，滑过裸露的肩头、精致的锁骨、深邃的沟壑直至那白润的腰侧。
随着吻的深入，鱼尾的摆动也变得愈发缠绵，那些付诸渴望的摩擦，牵着我与她深拥。
我的手指顺着她的脊背向下，直至抚过鱼尾上那些珠光鳞片，她终于依偎在我的怀中。
主上的吻……让天城有些目眩神迷了呢……
您说，此刻的天城，究竟是沦陷在了这片小小的天地之中……
还是……融化在您的温度里了呢？
呵呵~不必回答，天城会给您答案的……
她轻轻笑了笑，浅吻了下我的眼角，随即将唇贴上了我的耳畔。
没有区别哦，因为……主上就是天城的全世界呢~♥

sequence: 奢华！享梦！浮金湾！  神灯小姐的愿望游戏

scripts.say: 受莫里茨亲王的邀请，我来到了天台泳池寻找传说中的怪谈神灯。
她果然在这里——侧卧于池中央的浮板上，正摆弄着一盏造型奇特的灯器。
那身缀满细碎金链的泳装，随呼吸在月色下粼粼闪烁，裸露的肌肤在夜色中白得晃眼。
你已经找到神灯了？
找到？嘻嘻，不哦~我乃实现愿望的神灯精灵，是你亲手召唤出来的。
作为成功召唤我的奖励，让我们来玩个游戏吧？
嘻嘻嘻~不许拒绝哦？
她朝我勾了勾手指。待我走近池边俯下身，手腕便被她猛地攥住，将我一把拽入水池中。
水花尚未平息，她已经笑着将我扶上浮板，随后从背后紧密地贴了上来，湿漉漉的胸脯紧贴我的脊背，唇瓣几乎贴上耳廓。
嘻嘻……吓到了吗？
听说这样心跳的感觉和恋爱很像哦……指挥官也体会到了吗？
不过呢，我们的游戏才刚刚开始——
为了让今夜过得更有趣一些，我修改了部分怪谈规则~
那就是——许愿者和实现者身份互换！今夜，就由你来取悦我、实现我的愿望~嘻嘻嘻~
她的手从我腰侧滑到腹部，随即灵活地一转身体，从正面抱住了我。
修长的双腿缠上我的腰际，湿透的布料薄如蝉翼，几乎起不到任何阻隔作用。
如果你能做到的话，那我……就归你所有了哦~♪
嘻嘻嘻……来猜猜我的愿望是什么吧？
啊，对了，我可没说只有一个愿望哦~
我的愿望很多很多，多到……你今晚别想睡觉的程度哦~嘻嘻嘻~
她微微仰头与我对上视线，细葱般的手指划过我的背脊，仅凭指甲带起细小的战栗。
给你个提示，实现愿望的诀窍，就是要好好取悦我哦，要用尽……一切让我觉得有趣的方式~
比如……这样？
未等她说完，我顺势扣住她的手腕，将她轻轻按倒在浮板上。
浮板晃动，她毫无保留地展露在我眼前，浸湿的泳装勾勒出每一道柔软的弧度。
哇哇！！你你……
她显然没预料到我的反击，发出一声短促的惊呼，双腿下意识缠上我的腰。
呼……没想到你会这么……
嘻嘻嘻，把愿望交给你……果然是个正确的选择呢~
缓了口气，她又恢复到了之前那副愉悦的模样，随即用双腿带着我的腰向下扯。
浮板随水波轻轻荡漾，她身上的金链垂落，追随晃动的节奏，不时冰凉地刮过我的皮肤。
来吧，解开这些碍事的束缚，取悦彼此吧~♡
她伸出手在身后摸索，寻找着泳衣的卡扣，而我则咬住了那些链饰的搭扣。
几乎是同时，两处“咔哒”声响起，她温软的唇瓣堵住了我所有的呼吸与思绪。
这个吻漫长而湿润，直到彼此氧气将尽，她才稍稍分离。
不许睁眼哦~接下来……跟我来~♡
她掀翻浮板，带我落入池水之中，接着——一切声响与画面都被温柔地包裹、吞噬……

sequence: 奢华！享梦！浮金湾！  与“魔女”的星夜之约

scripts.say: “沿着幽密的小径，来到奇迹花园，‘魔女’在星光下等你……”
跟随着指引，我慢慢向前，终于——
在群星的见证下——欢迎来到“魔女”的奇迹花园，我的使魔。
晚宴即将拉开序幕，到我身边来吧。
“魔女”向我优雅地微微欠身，她果真站在漫天的星光之下，但比所有的星星都更加耀眼。
再靠近些，对，就这样……近到能看见我眼中映出的你。
为了褒奖你的如约而至，我将为你献上……
只属于你的魔法。
她裙裾轻旋，翩然起舞，周遭烛火的光晕随之荡漾，仿佛都被她的姿态牵引而起伏。
没有音乐相伴，潺潺的水流声让这一刻更加静谧幽然。
她嘴角勾起诱人的弧度，每个动作都带着奇特的魅力，牢牢地吸引我的目光。
这光影，这流转的夜风……都是仪式的序章。
用你的双眼记录，将此刻的画面铭记在你心底。
只是进行到一半，她便微微皱眉，动作逐渐慢下来。
唔，有些失算了……
维持这种魔法所需的魔力，似乎比我想象中更多……
我的使魔，能把你的“魔力”借给我吗？
呵呵，虽然不知道魔力为何物，却还是欣然点头应允了我的请求吗。
那就，握住我的手吧……
我伸出手去，奥古斯特的掌心如同玉石般温润微凉。
然后……抱住我吧。
再抱得更紧一点……
我的使魔，怀抱居然如此的温暖有力。
身体暖和起来了，魔力在恢复……
但仅仅这样，还是有点太慢了。
我该怎么做？
让渡力量……有更加快速的方式。
我的使魔，你准备好了么？
就用你的方式来吧……
冰蓝的烛火摇曳，“魔女”从怀中仰面向我，将双手温柔地绕上我的脖颈。
她的脸颊染上红晕，呼吸越来越近……
温润的……柔软的……颤抖着……索求着……
配合我的动作，这是只有我们两个人才能完成的魔法……
……逐渐掌握节奏了么，那就结束试探，再更加深入一点吧……
真是甘美的滋味，让人意犹未尽。
在即将分离之际，不知为何，我的双手却情不自禁地动了起来，将她紧紧抱住……
既然意犹未尽，那现在就由我来掌握主动吧。
我强硬地再次拉近与她的距离，接续起这段双人舞。
更加汹涌，更加狂野，更加炽烈，更加昂扬——
久久……久久才将她放开。
真是僭越的使魔呢，不过这倒是说明……
让你心动的魔法，已经奏效了。
我听得到哦，你心动的声音，它在一下一下地催促我……
魔法还没有结束，你要继续见证它即将诞下的奇迹吗？
于此刻，于此时。

sequence: 奢华！享梦！浮金湾！  水上的心跳“意外”

scripts.say: 午后，我静静躺在人工湖岸边的沙滩上，惬意地享受着宁静时光。
突然，我眼角的余光捕捉到不远处湖面上一抹不寻常的动静——
嗨~指挥官~
走近一看，只见Z15被包裹在一个巨大的透明球体中，正努力地向我挥着手。
她身着清凉的泳装，球体内壁与她肌肤几乎贴合无间，在阳光下折射出晃眼的光晕。
锵锵~是水上步行球哦~有了它，就可以在水上散步了~是不是很厉害？
水球随着她的动作悠悠漂到岸边，Z15“唰”地拉开防水拉链，带着灿烂的笑容探出头来。
指挥官一个人晒太阳多无聊呀~快来快来，和Z15一起玩吧~
未等我回复，Z15便抢先一步抓住了我的手腕，将我拉入了水上步行球。
拉链闭合的轻响后，我们便成为了这片小小天地的唯二居民，缓缓脱离了岸边的依靠。
水球内的空间对于两人来说实在有些局促。
我几乎紧贴着Z15的后背站立，能清晰感受到她脊背传来的温热，以及随呼吸微微起伏的节奏。
呜哇……指挥官一进来，这里就变得好热呢……
明明人家一个人的时候从没有这么热过……真奇怪~
或许是今天的阳光太烈了。
我们先回去，等晚上温度下降一些再出来玩吧。
嗯……指挥官说的好像很有道理呢……
那我们就先回去吧——欸呀~！
Z15脚下突然一个踉跄，整个人惊呼着向后仰倒，结结实实地撞进了我的怀里。
突如其来的重量让我也瞬间失去平衡，我们一同跌坐在了球壁上。
两人的重量此时完全偏向一侧，整个水球不受控制地在原地旋转起来。
一阵天旋地转后，Z15已然整个人趴伏在我身上，我完全动弹不得了。
透过湿透的泳装布料，Z15全身的热量毫无保留地向我袭来，不知是湖水还是汗液，让相贴的肌肤染上一片滑腻湿濡。
指挥官，你没事吧？
在水上步行球里，要保持平衡真的好难哦……你可以……帮帮我吗？
我试图用手臂和腰背的力量支撑她起身，但滑动的水球完全无处着力，一次次徒劳的尝试反而让我们贴得更紧。
最后，Z15彻底放弃了挣扎，整个人软软地瘫靠在了我身上。
真是抱歉~指挥官……Z15真笨，怎么都站不稳……
没办法了~看来，我们只能保持这样，慢慢“滚”回去了……
Z15的手臂有气无力地在球壁上扒拉了几下，水球非但没有靠近岸边，反而在涟漪推动下，朝着更开阔的湖心缓缓漂去。
咦……？我们怎么离岸边越来越远了呀……？
最终，在Z15的“努力”下，水球静静停泊在了湖心中央。
唔……不行了，指挥官……Z15已经，一点力气都没有了哦~
这里离岸边太远了，还完全没有其他人……
看来只能原地等待救援了呢……
没想到，只是玩水上步行球，也会遭遇事故……人家的运气，真是不好呢~
在救援到来之前，指挥官……
我们是不是……得找点两个人就能做的事情，来打发这——么长的时间呢~？

CN.title: 意外被困的捉迷藏游戏

sequence: 奢华！享梦！浮金湾！  意外被困的捉迷藏游戏

scripts.say: 午后，豪华游轮的顶层甲板处，被蒙着眼罩的Z14站在原地，手指紧张地绞着衣角。
呜呜……为、为什么是我当捉人鬼啊呜呜……
咳咳，我们准备开始找躲藏的地方了，Z14可以开始倒数了哦？
啊……！好、好的……一百、九十九……那个，如果我找得太慢，大家会不会觉得无聊……？
不会啦~我们倒希望你数得慢一点呢！
scripts.actorName: 奥托·冯·阿尔文斯莱本 [猎物与陷阱？]

scripts.say: 这样就有更充足的躲藏时间了！
唔……好像可以藏在书房里……
不可以说出来啦！
scripts.actorName: 奥托·冯·阿尔文斯莱本 [猎物与陷阱？]

scripts.say: 通讯中断。Z14深吸几口气，放下心来数完了最后几个数，随即摘下眼罩准备开始找人……
眼罩摘下的瞬间，她就和几只恰好落在她周围的海鸥对上了视线。
（什么时候来的……？！它们、它们这是要——？！）
一只胆大的海鸥试探性地蹦跶过来，紧接着，更多的海鸥围拢过来，在她头顶盘旋，发出响亮的叫声。
呜啊啊——别、别过来呀！
我听到甲板上传来了惨叫声，发生什么事了？！
（小声）欸欸——现在还在游戏进行中啊，怎么突然打开通讯了？
scripts.actorName: 奥托·冯·阿尔文斯莱本 [猎物与陷阱？]

scripts.say: 我、我被海鸥们困住了，现在动不了呜呜——
紧急情况！捉人游戏暂停，先一起帮Z14处理海鸥吧！
呜哇！这么多海鸥！附近都被占满了欸！
scripts.actorName: 奥托·冯·阿尔文斯莱本 [猎物与陷阱？]

scripts.say: 真的……好多……
而且好像都不怕人的，赶走后很快又飞回来了……
（嗅嗅）Z14……你中午吃什么了？
薯、薯条……？
（原来如此……）
有什么办法可以把这些海鸥吸引走吗？比如唱歌？
scripts.actorName: 奥托·冯·阿尔文斯莱本 [猎物与陷阱？]

scripts.say: 呃……那换一种……诗朗诵也不是不行，Z46可以现场编一个……致海鸥的十四行诗？
scripts.actorName: 奥托·冯·阿尔文斯莱本 [猎物与陷阱？]

scripts.say: 我想，十四行诗不是这么用的……
我在书上看到过，想吓唬它们的话，可以试着模仿其他动物的叫声……
其他动物……欸？！我、我来模仿吗！
因为你是它们的目标……？
scripts.actorName: 奥托·冯·阿尔文斯莱本 [猎物与陷阱？]

scripts.say: 我……那我试试……
Z14鼓足勇气，仰起头冲着盘旋在周围的海鸥大喊——
没效果呢……
scripts.actorName: 奥托·冯·阿尔文斯莱本 [猎物与陷阱？]

scripts.say: ……或者用手机闪光灯？听说闪光灯也能吓跑海鸥？
我感觉还是用闪光灯靠谱一点……
那就一起来给海鸥拍照吧。
经过一番“闪光灯大战”，众人在给海鸥们拍了无数张照片后——终于从海鸥堆里救出了Z14。
捉人游戏从室外转移到室内后重新开始，大家一直玩到傍晚才心满意足地离开了港口。

sequence: 奢华！享梦！浮金湾！  沙滩雕塑大赛进行中！

scripts.say: 这次是与皇家的正面对决，诸位，享受此刻的竞争吧！
scripts.actorName: 德意志 [艳阳下的“福利”时间]

scripts.say: 大家，按照现在的步调稳步推进就好，我们一定会胜利的！
似乎充斥着火药味的发言响起在和平的沙滩上，沙滩雕塑比赛正在进行，两边势要决出高下。
“为了平衡战局，不能让指挥官帮助任何一方！”她们是这么说的。
于是我躺在一旁享受正好的阳光。
考虑到城堡的结构，调整水与沙的比例……新的一桶沙子好了，请拿去用吧~
小心一点，再小心一点……呀！对、对不起，雅努斯又失误了……
没关系啦，重新再来就可以了，大家的城堡可不是一下子就能轻易建立起来的呢~
我这边已经完成封顶了，我来帮雅努斯吧。
龙尾部分的雕刻基本完成，接下来呢？
scripts.actorName: 斯佩伯爵海军上将 [未知的晚会]

scripts.say: 嗯，做得很棒，剩下的工作就放心交给我吧。再稍微处理下鳞甲就好……
真是的，为什么我也要参与这种过家家的比赛啊……
……虽然这条龙还挺帅的。
比赛战况焦灼，两边都在全力以赴，热闹的场景吸引了一些路过的目光。
大家，在比赛……都非常努力呢！
scripts.actorName: 安克雷奇 [海豚、海洋、游泳课]

scripts.say: 老师……睡着了？肚子，不盖着的话……会着凉。
scripts.actorName: 安克雷奇 [海豚、海洋、游泳课]

scripts.say: 安克雷奇，给老师……盖被子，暖暖的！
scripts.actorName: 安克雷奇 [海豚、海洋、游泳课]

scripts.say: 在众人的努力下，辉煌的城堡与凶猛的巨龙慢慢成型。
随着时间推移，比赛逐渐接近尾声……
完成了！
scripts.actorName: 德意志 [艳阳下的“福利”时间]

scripts.say: 哼，居然同时完成，不过铁血的钢铁巨龙可不会输给羊羔们躲藏的房子。
scripts.actorName: 德意志 [艳阳下的“福利”时间]

scripts.say: 毋庸置疑，和平的城堡当然比战争机器更为美丽~
既然如此，那就只能请指挥官来裁定胜利者了，嗯？指挥官呢？
scripts.actorName: 德意志 [艳阳下的“福利”时间]

scripts.say: 这里……什么时候多出了一个躺着的雕塑？
虽然毫无雕刻手法，整体看起来并未精心修饰……
scripts.actorName: 德意志 [艳阳下的“福利”时间]

scripts.say: 但这毫无疑问是指挥官！姿态和神韵简直浑然天成，像是下一秒就会活过来……！
我认为，这才是本次比赛的胜利者。
哼，没想到还能与你达成共识……这个雕塑的作者是谁？
scripts.actorName: 德意志 [艳阳下的“福利”时间]

scripts.say: 那、那个……这是……
scripts.actorName: 安克雷奇 [海豚、海洋、游泳课]

scripts.say: 众人议论的声音将我吵醒，我拨开身上的沙子，艰难地爬起。
比赛结束了？谁是赢家？
呀？！雕塑……变成指挥官了！
居然是这样……哼，那我就输得不冤了。
scripts.actorName: 德意志 [艳阳下的“福利”时间]

scripts.say: 看来这次的赢家是指挥官呢~只是有些可惜，美丽的雕像就这样消失了……
……我赢了？我什么时候参赛的？
嗯哼~！指挥官，准备好接受本小姐为赢家准备的奖赏吧？
以深渊之神的名义，该给指挥官奖励的应该是我才对！
亲爱的~我们可以换一个地方继续创作雕塑哦~
大家的意见最终转化成了对我的理解，于是我又一次躺回了沙滩。
创作……？大家一起？给老师……？
scripts.actorName: 安克雷奇 [海豚、海洋、游泳课]

sequence: 奢华！享梦！浮金湾！  此刻，与谁共赴？

scripts.say: 游乐场的傍晚，夕阳为各项游乐设备的轮廓镀上一层暖金色，缤纷的灯光正逐渐亮起。
耳畔，快门声此起彼伏了十几分钟后，终于——
好耶！集体大合照完成！
……不过指挥官，这张拍得有些匆忙，我担心有人没看到镜头。
趁天色还没暗，我们再认真拍一次好不好？
好啊，那就再拍一张吧。
在标枪欢快的“茄子！”声中，新一轮合照在倒数声中顺利完成。
就在众人围在一起查看照片时，杜伊斯堡来到了我的身旁。
指挥官真是温柔呢～满足了标枪的愿望。
那能不能……也满足一下我的小心愿呢？
嗯？什么心愿？
比如……两个人安安静静地独处一会儿？创造些只属于我们的小秘密之类的~
这样的纪念，可比拍照要特别多了，对吧？
然而我还没来得及做出回应，杜伊斯堡的话语便被关注着这边的几位听到了——
呵呵，真是听到了有趣的事情呢~难道指挥官对“创造小秘密”这么感兴趣吗？
那要不要去更高的地方？比如说……那边的摩天轮？
在那让人心跳加速的高度……说不定会发生更有趣的事哦~
嗯哼~摩天轮吗？这种选择倒还算不赖。
scripts.actorName: 海王星 [海洋女王的迎接]

scripts.say: 和指挥官单独享受这样的景色……应该是很特别的体验吧？
scripts.actorName: 海王星 [海洋女王的迎接]

scripts.say: 两人的话语仿佛往平静的水面投下石子，涟漪迅速扩散开来。
和……和指挥官……在小小的座舱里……呜哇哇哇……
总觉得会因为机器故障而停在空中呢……不过和指挥官在一起的话……
细碎的议论声在人群中蔓延，越来越多人眼睛亮了起来，纷纷看向那座缓缓转动的摩天轮。
哎呀，看来共识达成得很快呢。不过——
scripts.actorName: 圣路易斯 [邮轮上的诱人午后]

scripts.say: 摩天轮转一圈需要的时间可不短。如果每个人都想和指挥官单独乘坐一轮的话……
scripts.actorName: 圣路易斯 [邮轮上的诱人午后]

scripts.say: 恐怕要排到明天早上了哦？
scripts.actorName: 圣路易斯 [邮轮上的诱人午后]

scripts.say: 她的话语让气氛忽然变得微妙而安静。
霎时间，无数目光静静聚焦在我身上。
那么，亲爱的指挥官——
您打算……让谁成为今夜的第一位“旅伴”呢？呵呵~

sequence: 奢华！享梦！浮金湾！  特别拍摄计划

scripts.say: 人文区·香料市场
莫加多尔，红色山脉——两位挑战选手，能听清吗~
能听到哦~
scripts.actorName: 莫加多尔 [静谧一隅的燥热]

scripts.say: 呼……稍微有些紧张呢……
那我再重复一遍本次挑战节目的内容是——“从满满的香料气味中，找到藏身其中的指挥官”！
两位选手准备好了的话就出发吧！对了，不要取下你们身上的实时录像转播设备哦~
那可是最后用来证实你们比赛结果的最大依仗~
嗯……不过，这里的气味有些复杂呢……
肉桂、豆蔻、百里香……
scripts.actorName: 莫加多尔 [静谧一隅的燥热]

scripts.say: 指挥官，会藏在哪个方向呢？
（深嗅）哈啊——哈啊……我找到了♡~
scripts.actorName: 莫加多尔 [静谧一隅的燥热]

scripts.say: （深嗅）我也……是那个方向对吧？哦哦~♡
就是这样！要全力以赴哦！
为了避免影响正常体验风情街的其他同伴，莫加多尔专门规划了一条尽量不引人注意的路线。
嘘——六点钟方向，好像有人靠近了……气味有些熟悉，是谁呢……
scripts.actorName: 莫加多尔 [静谧一隅的燥热]

scripts.say: ……停在路中间了吗……啊，逗留片刻又转身离开了……？
那我们继续——
scripts.actorName: 莫加多尔 [静谧一隅的燥热]

scripts.say: 在找我吗？
勇气的声音从两人身后传来，被吓了一跳的莫加多尔和红色山脉连忙回头看去。
啸啸（吹哨声）——你们两位，在过去的十分钟内，故意避开了所有主干道对吧！
在货摊间穿插移动，还刻意停留在监控死角……行迹十分可疑，跟我走一趟吧！
欸……你不是已经离开了吗，怎么……
哼哼，我之前刻意让警戒汪吸引你们注意，再让警戒汪自主行动，由我偷偷潜伏过来抓人~
现在好好配合我调查吧！不然的话，我就要启动警报了哦——
就在勇气准备启动警报呼叫支援时，一阵奇异而柔和的香气随风飘来。
海筹端着一盏古老的黄铜香炉，从一家香料店的帷幔后缓步走出。
巡逻辛劳……我特地为勇气小姐准备了安神熏香，不妨一试？
她自然而然地走到勇气面前，将香炉略略抬高。勇气好奇闻了一下——
呜哇！好香的味道……！
就在勇气被香气引走注意力的瞬间，海筹向红色山脉和莫加多尔飞快地眨了眨眼。
趁现在，快走~
刚才还真是惊险呢——幸好节目组提前安排的救兵派上用场了。
啊！勇气似乎已经缓过神来了呢……快躲好！
唔……正好这里头没什么人，偷偷翻墙进去躲一会儿吧？
scripts.actorName: 莫加多尔 [静谧一隅的燥热]

scripts.say: 欸……我也要翻吗？
对！
scripts.actorName: 莫加多尔 [静谧一隅的燥热]

scripts.say: 毫不意外的是，两人在翻墙的过程中出了意外。
唔啊……翻墙的时候起码把眼罩摘开吧……等等，这里的味道……
scripts.actorName: 莫加多尔 [静谧一隅的燥热]

scripts.say: 啊……是指挥官的气息……！
你们这是……想干嘛？
顺利发现指挥官！大家，跟随肯特选手一起去找指挥官玩吧——♪

sequence: 奢华！享梦！浮金湾！  氤氲之中

scripts.say: 风情街深处，有一家依照古法建造的特色浴场。
混合着异域香料的芬芳热气袅袅升起，在镶嵌着彩色玻璃的穹顶下盘旋。
指挥官，请躺下吧……此番舟车劳顿带来的疲劳，就由我来为您纾解~
放松精神……把一切都交给我吧~♪
济安指引我俯卧在光滑如釉的石台上。石面温热，熨帖着肌肤。
原先积压于体内的些许的酸胀感，果然在她的指压下渐渐化开。
然而这份宁静仅仅持续了片刻，便被浴场入口的方向传来的一阵轻快脚步声所打断。
哼哼~♪原来指挥官躲在这里享受呢~
scripts.actorName: 巴拉卡少校 [死亡之神的戏谑]

scripts.say: 既然是独处的宁静时光……不稍微搅乱一点就太可惜了，对吧？呵呵~
scripts.actorName: 巴拉卡少校 [死亡之神的戏谑]

scripts.say: 比如像这样……
scripts.actorName: 巴拉卡少校 [死亡之神的戏谑]

scripts.say: 话音未落，那温暖的身躯便已贴到我身旁，一阵清冽又独特的香料气息一同袭来。
她的手指带着试探的意味，轻轻挠了挠我的腰侧。
而温热的呼吸随着她倾身的动作，若有似无地拂过耳畔。
如果我突然用力按下去的话……指挥官会露出什么样的表情呢？
scripts.actorName: 巴拉卡少校 [死亡之神的戏谑]

scripts.say: 哼哼~♪光是想想，就觉得比任何冒险都让人心跳加速呀~
scripts.actorName: 巴拉卡少校 [死亡之神的戏谑]

scripts.say: 你啊……看来是打定主意要捣乱了？
唔……是不是呢~这或许取决于指挥官的回答呢~
scripts.actorName: 巴拉卡少校 [死亡之神的戏谑]

scripts.say: 况且，要是你对我的特别服务不满意，也随时可以“惩罚”我嘛。
scripts.actorName: 巴拉卡少校 [死亡之神的戏谑]

scripts.say: 比如……用您的手，让我再也使不出捣乱的力气？我会好好配合的哦~
scripts.actorName: 巴拉卡少校 [死亡之神的戏谑]

scripts.say: 未等我出声回答，笔尖与纸面轻快摩擦的沙沙声，不知何时已在浴池一角响起。
噢噢……！这实在是……
scripts.actorName: 拉斐尔 [爱与美的秘密珍藏]

scripts.say: 太美了~！！
scripts.actorName: 拉斐尔 [爱与美的秘密珍藏]

scripts.say: 这氤氲的光影，放松与嬉闹交织的松弛感，还有指挥官此刻那无奈又纵容的神情……
scripts.actorName: 拉斐尔 [爱与美的秘密珍藏]

scripts.say: 不行……仅仅作为旁观者记录的话，已经完全不够了……
scripts.actorName: 拉斐尔 [爱与美的秘密珍藏]

scripts.say: 拉斐尔毫不犹豫地放下了素描本，从矮榻上起身，赤足踩过温润的石板，一步步走近。
在她眼中闪烁着的，是艺术家捕捉到绝妙主题时，才会迸发出的那种纯粹而炙热的光芒。
想要追求至高的艺术，就应该亲身融入，成为“美”的一部分——
scripts.actorName: 拉斐尔 [爱与美的秘密珍藏]

scripts.say: 指挥官……请允许我也加入这幅画卷吧~
scripts.actorName: 拉斐尔 [爱与美的秘密珍藏]

scripts.say: 我会用我的全部感官，将这份独一无二的体验，为您——也为艺术——深刻地铭刻下来的哦~♪
scripts.actorName: 拉斐尔 [爱与美的秘密珍藏]

scripts.say: 三人几乎同时贴近，下一秒，她们柔软的手指就轻轻落在我的身上……
……等、等等，你们……？
要好好享受我们的按摩服务哦，指挥官~
姿势放松——再放松一点嘛——
scripts.actorName: 拉斐尔 [爱与美的秘密珍藏]

scripts.say: 指挥官之后怎么“惩罚”人家都可以哦~现在……一起享受下刺激的事情吧~
scripts.actorName: 巴拉卡少校 [死亡之神的戏谑]

sequence: 奢华！享梦！浮金湾！  沙洲越野赛！

scripts.say: 沙丘之上，轮胎卷起尘沙飞扬，靓丽的身影们疾驰而过。
我和明石一同坐在赛场的直播室，作为被邀请的解说一同对赛事进行实时讲解。
现在正在为各位观众们直播的是无限制沙漠越野赛，人气竞速选手们正在互相追赶！
今天的赛况似乎比之前更加激烈呢！指挥官对此有什么见解呢？
大概因为本次比赛的奖品相当丰厚吧！想必大家也很想知道冠军将获得什么吧？
由明石商店提供的冠军奖品就是——“与指挥官一起的温泉包场券”！
由于我的朗诵速度太快，当我意识到自己说了什么的时候，一切已经来不及了。
眼下能做的，只有先伸手关闭麦克风。
等等，之前我看台词板上的奖品明明只有“温泉包场券”，为什么变了？
哇哇？！关、关岛什么都不知道哦！
指挥官，比赛已经越来越激烈了，我们还是先把注意力放回越来越激烈的赛事中吧！
正如关岛所说，直播无人机传回的画面里，选手们的眼神似乎变得更加火热了。
原来Honey才是比赛的真正奖品吗？那么就没有不认真起来的理由了呀！
scripts.actorName: 新泽西 [漆黑的超极速前奏]

scripts.say: 即使是友谊赛也不能手下留情了……埃塞克斯，目标是第一！
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 嘿咻！总之大家都要动真格了对吧？
呵呵，这信息我可是早就知道了哦，不枉我免费帮明石处理了那么多工作呢！
Hello Everybody！欢迎各位继续收听赛事直播♪
目前赛程已经过半，湖泊的对面就是终点！
在刚才的复杂地形赛段中，Z52以极致的灵活优势遥遥领先，其他选手能否反超呢？
接下来就是最关键的阶段……爆燃吧，雷火之心！
哦哦~Z52的速度再次提升，但是在她身后，一抹蓝色疾驰而来！
最大最强的Black Dragon虽迟但到~Honey，要好好看着我哦！
scripts.actorName: 新泽西 [漆黑的超极速前奏]

scripts.say: 新泽西位列第一，还有两位选手不见踪影，难道冠军已经被提前锁定了吗？
比赛越来越精彩了！收视率越来越高了呢！
只要保持这个势头就可以拿下honey了！等等……那边从沙丘上飞跃下来的是？！
scripts.actorName: 新泽西 [漆黑的超极速前奏]

scripts.say: 这么陡峭的沙丘，就算是无限制比赛，骑摩托飞跃也太乱来了吧——！
scripts.actorName: 新泽西 [漆黑的超极速前奏]

scripts.say: 必须……要化不可能为可能！
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 距离终点只剩不到三百米，一鼓作气吧！
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 突然杀出的埃塞克斯让战局再次发生变化！冠军究竟花落谁手？！
收视率创下新纪录了——指挥官，我们赛后也要好好庆祝一下哦♪
咳，先专心比赛……
可惜，最后的赢家只会是我~
——黑色的跑车忽然出现在了终点前方！神兵天降，是迪普莱克斯！！
她的跑车加装了飞行模块，所以才可以从空中轻松越过湖泊？！
不枉我得到消息后，特地请加斯科涅帮忙改装了赛车呢。
无论什么时候，情报才是决胜的第一要素哟~冠军我就不客气地收下了！
黑色跑车越过终点线，迪普莱克斯款款下车，愉快地朝无人机眨了眨眼。
本次比赛的优胜者是——迪普莱克斯！恭喜~
请前来直播室，领取你的冠军奖品——欸指挥官，别关我的麦克风，别——哔哔哔——

sequence: 奢华！享梦！浮金湾！  昙花一现的宝石

scripts.say: 指、指挥官……您来了！
雅努斯，看到了不得了的东西……！
直通酒店顶层的电梯门一打开，雅努斯像受惊的小猫一样扑到我怀里。
我接住她，安抚地摸了摸她的头。
别担心，我来了，发生什么事情了？
5分钟前，我接到了明石的紧急通知，让我尽快赶到穹顶酒店……就有了刚才的一幕。
当时，雅努斯只是来泳池喊猫猫们回家吃饭……
结果看到泳池里，有什么亮闪闪的东西在上下浮动……！
凑近了才发现，那个东西是、是……
是宝石喵！失踪的宝石居然出现在泳池里了喵！
身后的电梯“叮”一声打开，明石火急火燎地一个弹射飞扑进泳池，开始猛捞。
这下明石的保证金有救了喵——！
宝石，漂在水面上……？
阳光洒过被搅动的水面，波光晃得人眼花。除了四处翻找的明石外，这里看起来和寻常泳池没什么两样。
是、是的……雅努斯也是第一次见到……
所以我立刻就去找人来帮忙了……
我们是维护假期秩序的度假警备队！接到报告后立刻就赶到了报案现场！
但等我们赶到时，泳池里已经什么都没有了！
没有！没有！哪里都没有喵——！！
没错~我潜到水下找了好几圈哦，确实什么也没有～
会不会是看错了？不能排除出现海市蜃楼的可能性！
宝石自己飞走了也有可能！毕竟它都能飘在水上了呢！
说到底，那么大、那么重的宝石竟然能浮在水面上……就已经很奇怪了吧？
可、可是……我真的亲眼看到了……
从常识的角度考虑，宝石的确不应该漂浮在水面上。
但我相信雅努斯不会看错。

options.content: 宝石被施加了“漂浮魔法”
还有什么我们不知道的内幕

scripts.say: 这其中恐怕有什么蹊跷，比如——
喵啊啊——现在不是讨论宝石为什么会浮起来的时候喵！！重点是，它现在去哪儿了！
那可是关系着明石的赔偿金……不对，是关系着大家能不能继续安心享受假期的重要宝物喵！
指挥官！赶紧组织警备队的人手，展开调查吧！
等等，明石。
你知道的，地毯式的搜索可是很费人力的，最重要的是——
现在是休假期间。
没错！我们本来都准备好去沙滩晒太阳了！
想要我们加班调查的话……得有点“动力”才行呢~
你们……这是什么意思喵……？
调查小队的调查经费、加班津贴、奖金、高温补贴，以及冰淇淋供应……
和巨额赔偿金比起来，应该不算什么吧？
……呜……我、我知道了喵……！
组织调查花费的全部费用，全、全部由明石承担喵……！只要你们能把宝石找回来就好……！
好耶——！有冰淇淋吃啦——！
成交。
就这样，针对失踪宝石“浮金珍宝”的调查行动，正式启动——

sequence: 奢华！享梦！浮金湾！  海鸥的踪迹

scripts.say: 不屈，你那边有找到什么吗？
找到了羽毛、鸟粪、巧克力包装纸、玻璃弹珠、半包薯条……
就是没有宝石……！它真的会在鸟窝里吗……？
呜……果然不该听勇气的建议来鸟窝里找的！头发上沾满了羽毛，连宝石的影子都没看见！
书上说鸟儿喜欢收集亮闪闪的东西嘛！
而且“浮金珍宝”还是从那么高的地方凭空消失的……肯定是被鸟儿叼走了！
从现场状况来看，这个推测确实合理。
我走到三人身边，伸手帮她们掸了掸头发上沾着的羽毛。
你们看！指挥官也同意呢！那我们就继续搜查鸟窝——
等等！你们快看天上——
海鸟……全都在朝同一个方向飞！
那边出什么事了吗？我们快去看看！
顺着鸟群飞行的方向，我们来到了一处露天泳池边。
呜……我已经把薯条全部都交出来了……真的没有吃的啦……
只见Z14正被一大群海鸥团团围住，整个人瑟瑟发抖，看起来快要哭出来了。
Z14小姐遇到麻烦了！我们快去帮帮她吧！
啸啸（吹哨声）——警告！警告！
海鸥你们扰乱秩序了哦！
勇气一边吹哨一边挥舞双手，这突如其来的声势将所有海鸥都吓得四散飞走了。
谢、谢谢你们……得救了……
不用谢！维护公共秩序是警备队的职责哦！
不过……如果鸟群聚集不是因为宝石，那它到底去哪儿了呢……
果然还是得继续搜查鸟窝才行！
那、那个……你们是在找……一颗宝石吗？
刚才那些海鸥争抢薯条的时候……我看到有几只没有靠过来……
它们好像在围在一颗很大的……宝石？……旁边……
巨大的宝石……是“浮金珍宝”！一定没错！
你看到它们往哪个方向飞了吗？
嗯……它们穿过黄金海岸，向海风酒店的方向飞去了。
太好了，终于有新线索了！那我们继续展开调查吧！
她们……确定“巨大的”宝石是能被海鸥带走的吗？

sequence: 奢华！享梦！浮金湾！  屋顶上的“海盗”

scripts.say: 沿着海岸线一路打听，我们终于在海风酒店的露天泳池边，找到了另一位目击者——
巨大的宝石，“浮金珍宝”……
埃姆登的确看到了哦。
「毕竟这一处露天泳池的视野很不错，能看到不少有趣的事情呢~」
太好了！看来我们离找到宝石不远了！
你有看见那些海鸥往哪里飞了么？
海鸥……？不对哦。
「带着宝石的，是两个人呢~」
什么！宝石被人抢走了？！
这次的案件果然不是普通的意外呢！必须要把犯人绳之以法才行！
但也有可能只是路过捡到宝石的无辜舰船吧……
不可能的。港区的伙伴都知道我们正在寻找丢失的宝石，肯定不会故意藏起来的！
情况变得越来越复杂了……
埃姆登，再详细描述一下你当时看到的情况吧。
当时我们正在练习水上瑜伽……「就看到了，抱着亮晶晶的东西，在相邻的屋顶上跳跃的两道人影。」
一边说着，埃姆登伸手指向远处那片连绵的建筑物。
「简直就像海盗跳船一样呢~」
在屋顶上跳来跳去……像海盗跳船一样……？
那也可以是极限运动爱好者吧。比如喜欢跑酷什么的……
说的也对呢，为什么但是一看到就觉得像海盗呢……？「人类，你发现盲点了呢。」
埃姆登若有所思片刻，忽然想起什么似的眨了眨眼。
唔——大概因为，那些孩子穿的衣服，和皇家财富号她们很像吧~
总之，她们的落脚点应该是风情街附近……「之后就再也没有出现过了。」
我们距离目标越来越近了……！
指挥官，快继续前进吧！

sequence: 奢华！享梦！浮金湾！  神·灯·小·姐

scripts.say: 浮金湾特产烤肠——限时五折特惠，错过今天等一年——
浮金湾千年古街主题明信片、手串、书签，支持定制，送人自用都合适啦~
这里就是风情街！人群密集，注意随身物品哦！
好、好多人啊……！
我记得这条“千年古街”，大概是明石上周新建的。
欸~那就不奇怪了。
指挥官快看！前面那两个人手里拿着的——是“浮金珍宝”吧！
还没等我反应过来，勇气已经一把抓住我的手腕冲了过去——
不许动，把宝石交出来！
呜哇……！
那个，如果你们也想要“浮金珍宝”微缩雪糕的话……其实，可以去那边买……
顺着Z11手指的方向，一家挂着“浮金珍宝批发”招牌的小铺映入眼帘。
指挥官，要带一根“浮金珍宝”微缩雪糕回去做纪念吗？百分百还原真品，现在下单还有买一送一活动哦。
居、居然是仿制品？！
仔细一看，整条风情街上几乎人人手里都拿着一颗“浮金珍宝”。
要在这么多宝石中，找到真正的那一颗，无异于在大海里找一滴水。
怎么办……线索彻底断了……
嘻嘻~几位彷徨的旅人啊~
如果你们是在寻找失物……神灯或许可以给予启示呢~
循声望去，莫里茨亲王正悠闲地躺在地毯上，手中把玩着一盏金色的神灯。
这次是卖神灯玩具的吗……？

options.content: 我想知道“浮金珍宝”的下落
我不买玩具

scripts.say: 不~我是神·灯·小·姐~可以实现指挥官你的愿望哦~
都说了我不是卖玩具的，是神·灯·小·姐啦！快许愿吧~
我想知道“浮金珍宝”的下落
嘻嘻~我这就实现你的愿望~
灯神啊，请将神力赐予我，给予我启明吧——
嗯嗯，我知道了……最开始是穹顶酒店的泳池……然后经过港口……接着出现在海风酒店附近……
这是我们之前搜查过的地点……她居然都说对了？
也可能是跟踪了我们哦！
而现在——宝石正在向奇迹花园的方向移动。
指挥官，你的愿望实现了~如何？神灯的神力有没有让你心悦诚服呀~？嘻嘻嘻~
能打听到我们的行动轨迹，看来你做了不少功课。
灯神可是无所不知哦~打听消息的水平也是一流呢~
（那大概是Z14告诉她的吧……）
不过，你怎么会知道宝石现在的方位？
因为我是灯神哦，嘻嘻嘻~
说实话。
……而且我还知道——是谁带走了宝石，嘻嘻嘻嘻~
灯神小姐请告诉我答案。
哼哼~是时候揭晓怪谈背后的真相了——
她话音未落，一旁摊位的大帐篷忽然窸窸窣窣地动了起来，随后——
嘿嘿~终于找到你啦~指挥官~
海豚号？！

sequence: 奢华！享梦！浮金湾！  “魔法”花园的晚宴

scripts.say: 饿……好饿……
自从被风暴送来这里……又和飓风船团的小妹妹失散了之后……已经一天没吃东西了……
这下真的完蛋了啦……！
再坚持下，你看前面——呼哇~！那里好像在办宴会，灯光亮得跟白天似的。
只要穿过这片沙漠，我们就能大吃一顿了。
对了，该轮到你来照看这个宝石了。
等等，我明明五分钟前才把它交给你！我们说好半小时轮换一次的吧？
啧，这宝石虽然好看，但是又大又沉……
对了，不如先把它埋在这里，吃饱了再回来拿？
不行不行！这里狡猾的敌人太多了……！
所以还是随身保管比较安全，要藏的话，也得找个超级——超级安全的地方才行！
超级安全的地方——恐怕得是你的肚子里了……等等……
嗯？你闻到了吗？
是、是烤肉的香味！我们就要到了……！
别放松警惕，晚宴里或许会有认出我们不属于这里的人！要谨慎行动！
不过现在……为了晚餐，全速前进吧！
……这种主题风格的聚会，倒是第一次参加……
scripts.actorName: 阿尔汉格尔斯克 [与魔女同行]

scripts.say: ……有种特别的感觉……

scripts.say: ……竟然就这么混进来了。这些家伙穿的衣服，比我们还和这座城市格格不入啊……
烤肉！美酒！……等等，这不会是陷阱吧……？！
我检查过了，这里很安全……总之，快点填饱肚子，再计划下一步如何行动吧。
与此同时——
指挥官，我感知到了哦~你要找的人和宝石，都在这个花园里~
在海豚号的帮助下，我们一路追踪到了奇迹花园。
这里正在举行一场盛大的晚宴，灯火如星，人声欢腾。
好多好吃的……这会是恭喜我们找回“浮金珍宝”的庆功宴嘛~
嘿嘿~能成功找回宝石不只是警备队的功劳啦，多亏有指挥官和海豚号的帮助……
先别擅自妄想了啦！宝石还没找到呢！
这处场地很大，集中搜查很容易惊动其他在享受晚宴的人，而且效率也比较低。
这样，大家分开行动，去寻找目标人物吧。
明白！
根据海豚号的描述，她碰巧和安妮女王复仇号、冒险号一起组队寻宝时遭遇了风暴，被送到了这里。
其实在见到海豚号之前，我心里就有所猜测。
掠夺宝石、海盗、跳船……以上种种特征，都和皇家财富号之前在梦中，对我介绍的那位复仇女王船团的团长吻合。
指挥官~这边这边！我找到她们啦！

sequence: 奢华！享梦！浮金湾！  奇迹之光

scripts.say: 安妮，我又拿了三盘烤肉回来！这里的食物居然全都可以随便拿哦~！
嗯——这个世界的食物味道确实不错。
再分我一点。
没问题~我再去囤几盘当作应急口粮——

options.content: 你们就是安妮女王复仇号和冒险号吧

scripts.say: 嗨~好久不见啦~
哇——！有、有人找上门了……！一定是来抢宝石的坏人……！
别自乱阵脚了。既然是跟着海豚号找过来的，那大概不是我们的敌人吧。

options.content: 我是碧蓝航线的指挥官

scripts.say: 你——对，就是你，看着是个领袖的家伙。报上身份来吧。
经过一番情报交换——我向她们说明了“浮金珍宝”对这座城市的意义，安妮则简短讲述了她们被风暴卷来后的经历。
所以说，你们是从天上掉下来的时候，正好把浮金大厦上的宝石砸飞了？
没错。
落地后我看它亮闪闪的挺好看，就顺手带上了。
不过，既然这个东西对你们意义非凡……我就卖指挥官一个人情，还给你们就是了。
我们混进晚宴厅前把宝石藏在了一个安全的地方~我现在就带你们去拿！
一行人跟随安妮女王复仇号和冒险号，来到奇迹花园的喷泉旁。
宝石居然藏在喷泉里……
最安全的藏宝地点，当然是自己都打不开的机关里面啦~
没错，只需要打开这个出水口……
……我按。我按。
奇怪，这个机关怎么打不开了……？
这下怎么办……总不能把喷泉拆了吧？
奥古斯特·冯·帕塞瓦尔——这场魔女晚宴的主持人，向两位远道而来的客人致以问候。
看来，你们将什么东西藏进我亲手布置下的魔法装置里了呢。
这种时候，只需要施展魔力，稍加引导……
就可以打开喷泉上的封印了。
奥古斯特手腕轻转，如同施展魔法一般。
只见喷泉的顶部自动打开，水流随之变换，虹光之中——璀璨的宝石缓缓升起。
好厉害……！
她刚刚是不是悄悄按了喷泉的遥控器……？
几乎是在找回“浮金珍宝”的同时，我收到了来自明石的通讯。
指挥官！你们成功了喵！！！
现在尽快立刻马上把它送回浮金大厦吧~！！
明石已经为你们准备好了惊喜喵~!
我将失而复得的“浮金珍宝”重新安置在顶端的基座上。
之前提供过诸多帮助的同伴们也纷纷到场，仰头见证着此刻。
片刻沉寂后，宝石内部渐渐亮起柔和的光——
璀璨的光芒从大厦顶端倾泄而下，仿佛光之瀑布，在夜空中蔓延、生长，最终化作一棵笼罩城市的、巨大而梦幻的“光之树”。
好、好漂亮……
这可真是……如同施展了点亮整座城市的魔法呢~
想不到那个宝石居然还有这种作用。
这就是明石所说的惊喜吧。
没错喵~浮金大厦的楼身在之前的风暴中受损了，修复时明石特地拜托达·芬奇和灵敏加装了灯光表演模块喵！
好厉害！连天上的流星也是灯光效果吗？像真的一样！
那个……我觉得好像是真的流星哦？
哇啊！真的是流星雨！大家快许愿——不然流星雨要结束啦！
众人纷纷闭上双眼，双手交握，对着流星许下了属于自己的愿望。
绚烂星光之下，这场奇迹般的假日寻宝故事，迎来了它最美好的结尾——
许愿结束后，众人三三两两地往回走去。
安妮，冒险号，你们许下的愿望，可以告诉我么？
当然是想在这里多玩一会儿~
这里不光有这么多美味的食物，还有安全的旅店~
那你应该向我许愿才对呢。
毕竟要是想回去的话，我随时都有办法。
不过嘛……
安妮女王看向我，耸了耸肩。
我也想再多待一阵子就是了。

sequence: The Opulent! The Glamorous! Luxury Bay!  1 Time to Wake Up, Commander

scripts.say: Commander... Commander, it's time to get up.
Being a sleepyhead is unbecoming for a commanding officer.
I hear a whisper in the dark, and at the same time, I feel something moist and sleek against my ear.
Opening my eyes, I find Götz staring right at me from close up. Her cool fingertips are tracing my neck.
Heheh... You're finally awake, my dear Commander.
My... I can feel your heart racing. Are you perhaps volunteering to become my treat?
I've been feeling quite famished, actually... Maybe I should take a little taste...♪
With a dangerous glint in her eyes, Götz closes in on me... and then stops.
...My, it seems someone is intruding on us.
Before she can even finish her words, the room quakes.
Commander... Commander, it's time to get up.
Being a sleepyhead is unbecoming for a commanding officer.
Hearing a familiar voice, my consciousness surfaces into clarity.
I open my eyes with effort and find that Götz is besides me after all.
Even groggy as I am, I see her expression is more confident than alluring.
You're finally awake, Commander.
Her cool fingertips gently touch my neck.
I gaze out the plane's window and see our destination –
A collection of ornate, radiant buildings surrounded by a vast desert and blue seas.
To be honest, I was a bit nervous when that unexpected storm formed as we approached Luxury Bay's airspace...
But thankfully, we were able to brave the storm without issue.
The city that shimmers like gold is at hand.
The vacation everyone's been waiting for is finally about to begin♪
After making a landing at the airport, we board a car that takes us to our hotel.
Once we settle down, Akashi comes over to give me a tour of the town.
Nya, Commander! Welcome to the Luxury Bay, nya!
This is a top class luxury resort that stands head and shoulders above the rest! The climate and view are both perfect, and there's no shortage of fine cuisine and entertainment, nya!
The Tower of Luxury you see over there is this town's landmark, nya!
Wow. It really is glittering in the sun.
Of course, nya! I picked this place after much scrutiny!
At the top of that Tower of Luxury is a jewel everyone calls the Star of Luxury, nya! It shines bright in the night and stands as a symbol of Luxury Bay's wealth.
A symbol of wealth... In other words... Something I couldn't afford even if I poured all the money I have into it, nya...
...Wait, what is the meaning of this, nya?! Where's the Star of Luxury?!
How did such a large, precious jewel just up and disappear, nya?!
I look up in the same direction as Akashi, and indeed, I can't see any jewel on the top of the building.
Nyaaaa! My money! My deposit!
I had to put down a huge deposit to make a reservation for our vacation nya!
The contract said that if we end up damaging or losing any of the town's valuables, I have to pay a sizable sum in reparations nya!

options.content: Sure.
I have an idea.

scripts.say: Nya... If I can't get my deposit back, Commander, won't you please share some of your profits with me as your business partner, nya...?
I don't mind, but we should come up with a good long-term plan.
If we set up a solid plan for services we can offer in the pre-opening period, our profits should be high when we formally open the place.
Rather than coming up with a contingency plan, we should be thinking in the long term.
If we set up a solid plan for services we can offer in the pre-opening period, our profits should be high when we formally open the place.
Besides, it's not like the jewel just took off and ran away on its own. We have all of Luxury Bay booked, so let's take our time and look for it thoroughly.
That's a very convincing argument... Or so I'd like to say, nya!
But between having to look for the jewel and coming up with ways to improve our services... I'll end up being busier than usual instead of enjoying my vacation, nya!

sequence: The Opulent! The Glamorous! Luxury Bay!  2 A Gift Dedicated to You

scripts.say: As the night sea breeze caresses my cheek, the sea sparkles under the moonlight.
During my beachside stroll, I see a figure wavering in the light like a jellyfish, mirroring the rolling of the waves.
...Commander... Over here...
I walk over to her.
U-2501 floats face-up in the water, looking up at the stars, her long hair swaying in the water.
The helicopter is ready and on standby...
We're ready to set off whenever you are...
I want to show you the surprise we've spent days preparing together... from high up in the sky...
It was a secret, so I had to call you out like this...
Her voice is a soft whisper, yet contains an undeniable mixture of shyness and joy.
I'm really... so happy.
Getting to spend time with you... Even just this brief moment... fills my heart with joy. Ehehe...
Night diving equipment all set...
It's time we set out, too...
I really hope... you have a good time... Ehehe~♪
U-2501 nestles her chin onto my shoulder.
And then, with the nimbleness of a fish, she gracefully slips through my arms and dips into the water.
The helicopter takes off with a loud roar, and through the window I see the boundless blue expanse of the sea.
The water sways like a tapestry of black velvet.
From within it, a faint pink light rises up.
And then two, three... Countless lights begin floating over the water.
Like stars fallen into the sea, they shimmer, shift and realign to form the shape of a heart over the water...
Everyone, take your spots~
Anchorage... is ready!
Phew, I made it in time~
G-Give me a second, I'm not ready yet... Passing through!
Wait, you all have your radios on! The Commander can hear you running around!
Oh, but that's not too bad, is it? It might even stoke the Commander's expectations more.
Uh... How am I supposed to wave these heart-shaped lights again?
I'll do it like I'm attending a rock concert.
Haha, can't let you beat me on that front!
I hear all their familiar voices from the radio.
And while the heart's outline were hazy at first, the lights grow ever brighter and clearer.
So this is how everyone feels about the Champion. I can sense that strong feeling among us.
You always look after all of us, big brother... S-so this time, we all want to... answer your feelings in kind...
Come on, everyone, wave your heart lights to the rhythm! Let's show Owner our surprise!
Let's go! 3...

scripts.actorName: Queen Anne's Revenge [Call of the Creeping Embrace]

scripts.say: 1... Wave!
The massive heart starts throbbing over the water.
Ehehe, can you see us, Commander?
This throbbing heart represents our feelings for you!
Let our feelings reach you, Master... Please, accept them.
All the warm, tender love in our hearts ♥
Thank you for spending the best vacation ever with us...
This is it... The surprise we prepared for you♪

sequence: The Opulent! The Glamorous! Luxury Bay!  2 A Gift Dedicated to You
The Opulent! The Glamorous! Luxury Bay!  3 Shimmering Splashes Above the Clouds

scripts.say: C-Commander... You're here!
I head up to the rooftop pool at Janus's invitation. The afternoon breeze sweeps through the clouds, forming ripples in the water.
Janus isn't in the water, but reclining on a waterside bed, looking at the edge of the pool with tentative eyes.
The scenery on the top floor blends in perfectly with the sky, revealing a coastline stretching as far as the eye can see, and the scenery of a vibrant city below.
Isn't it a gorgeous view? Want to take a look around with me, Janus?
Oh, um... I...
Janus jolts at my words. She doesn't even look up, instead burying her head in a pillow.
I-I'm sorry... I-I haven't been able to get up for a while now...
The wind is so strong... I feel like the moment I let go of the pillow, I might get blown away...
I'm sorry, Commander!
I invited you here, yet I can't even get into the pool...
Saying this, Janus grabs the pillow harder and buries her face into it.
Don't worry, you'll be fine.
I sit next to Janus and gently take her hand.
Janus's cool hand is damp with sweat, and she is trembling like a scared kitten.
It'll be alright. You'll be safe. I'll hold you tight.
I wrap my hand around hers, using my other hand to wipe the sweat from her brow.
This makes Janus relax her stiff muscles and entrust her weight to me.
Close your eyes, listen to the wind and focus on the warmth in your hand.
Alright... Commander, your hand is so warm...
Now, take a deep breath. Inhale, and then slowly... exhale.
As I guide her, I pat her still-stiff shoulders to help soothe her trembling.
After a few deep breaths, Janus's shaking starts to subside, and warmth returns to her fingertips.
Phew... I feel a little better...
Then why don't we take a walk by the poolside?
You don't have to open your eyes if you don't want to. I'll hold your hand the whole time.
Yes... I think I'll be fine so long as you're with me!
I help Janus to her feet and lead her to the pool, hand in hand. We carefully go one step at a time.
Despite being buffeted by the wind, Janus does not cower and only grips my hand tighter.
The poolside is right in front of us, so we decide to go into the water.
I'll let go for just a second. Don't worry, I'm right in front of you.
Okay... I'm not afraid. With you, I can do this...!
Having you with me gives me courage, Commander!
Taking another deep breath, Janus dives into the pool, and I catch her in an embrace.
It feels like I could reach out and grab the clouds...! And the distant sea, too. It sparkles so much... It gives me courage!
Janus rests her head on my shoulder, her voice as soft as a breeze caressing the water's surface.
If you hadn't encouraged me, I wouldn't have gotten to see this gorgeous view... I'm so happy, Commander.
So... Won't you stay with me a little longer? Just a little bit...
The water's surface rippling with her laughter reflects Janus with a blissful smile on her lips.

sequence: The Opulent! The Glamorous! Luxury Bay!  4 Mingling Heartbeats

scripts.say: The rumble of a helicopter's rotors reverberates through the Tower of Luxury's rooftop.
As I approach, Mogador emerges from the helicopter's open cabin door.
Commaaaander... You finally came for me...
Waiting for you for so long has made my body burning with heat♥
Come. Let's go as high as those clouds...
I take her hand and board the swaying aircraft. The helicopter begins its ascent.
The strong, cold winds mercilessly lash at Mogador's bare skin.
But, it doesn't seem to bother her one bit. She instead reaches out her arms as if to catch the wind.
Her cheeks aflush with excitement, she turns an expectant gaze toward me.
Aaah...♥ Commander, can you feel it?
This wind... Aaah, I feel it on my skin...
If I were to jump off, the wind would hit me even harder, wouldn't it...?
It would blow all the unnecessary thoughts out of my mind... And all that will be left is pure... excitement... ♥
And did you know? The moment a person experiences true weightlessness... It turns their world upside down♥
That sounds like an unusual experience.
Unusual doesn't even begin to describe it...♥
...Having nothing to cling to but each other, falling helplessly together with you...
Entrusting everything to you...
Aaah... Just imagining it makes me so... ♥
She starts panting, her cheeks flush over as she peers into my eyes.
Gehehe... Let's jump together, Commander...
Let's tear through the wind and fall into the sky...
Together, forever, as we plummet into the clouds...♥
...Let's not also throw the concept of safety out the window.
Aaah... If there's one thing that's dangerous for me, it'd be you, Commander... ♥
Can you tell? Just by sitting here, my heart starts to race... My body gets all hot and sweaty...
All because you're right here with me, Commander... ♥
But then, electronic beeping fills the aircraft.
A signal that it has reached its planned altitude.
Aah, this sound... It's finally time♥
All this heat, all this excitement... This is what I've been waiting for...♥
Mogador holds my hand tightly, her balmy fingers interlocking with mine.
She pulls herself close to me, and after letting out a feverish sigh, turns her nose to me.
Mmh... Haah~♥ I have to memorize... your scent... ♥
No looking down now. Just look at me... Look me in the eyes♥
Now... Let's fall together.
Until our heartbeats... Mingle into one...♥
And so, without a moment's hesitation, we jump out of the helicopter.
We're wrapped in a sense of weightlessness as the helicopter rapidly pulls away from us. The wind howls in our ears.
Woohooo! Here it cooooomes!
Commaaaander! Isn't this aweeeesome?!
I'm too excited to answer, and all I can do is keep my arms around Mogador.
As we fall, embracing one another, the wind trying to tear us apart is only making us hold onto each other all the tighter.
Aha~♥ You're holding me even tighter... I'm so happy!
All the sweat dries off so quickly, but wherever you touch me... Aaah... It feels so hot, it's like I'm melting♥
You didn't hear me?! Then I'll say it one more time!
Commander! I'm the only thing on your mind right now, right?!
The wind is blowing your smell away, but that's fine! You're already a part of me!
Mogador presses her forehead against mine.
You're all that's in my eyes right now... Can you see that?♥
Once we fall through the clouds... Hang onto me even tighter♥
The world around us turns into a pure, damp white. The howling of the wind suddenly cuts off as cold, soft mist wraps around us.
The mist makes me unable to see, but in exchange, my other senses become keener.
I feel the warmth of her skin on mine. I sense the racing rhythm of a pulse, and can't tell if it's hers, mine or both. And...
And I can hear Mogador's ragged breathing, heavy with excitement.
Right here... nobody can ever find us –
Just the two of us, falling, forever and ever –
Geheheh! It's a moment for just the two of us, until we touch down♥

sequence: The Opulent! The Glamorous! Luxury Bay!  5 Honeyed Afterglow

scripts.say: I enter the lounge, seeking a reprise from the noise of the party. There, I find Saint Louis lying down, with a jar of marmalade rolling beside her.
Her skin is flushed with intoxication, making her look quite defenseless.
Ugh... My head feels sluggish...
...Commander?
My apologies... I was looking for a quiet place to sober up in when I happened upon this spot...
She very much looks like she's out of it, with jam clinging to her skin.
Oh, this...
This jam... Its fresh aroma has a hint of sourness to it...
I thought tasting something sour would help shake off the intoxication...
I have to remain clear-headed... to continue carrying out my sacred duty... of protecting you...
As she speaks, her fingertip casually traces the jam, drawing a golden thread of honey.
When I tasted the jam, my body got all hot instead.
So I thought slathering it on my skin might make me feel better...
She unconsciously touches the corner of her lips, eyeing her own sticky fingers...
A flustered smile, like a child's, plays over her lips.
And you can see the state I ended up in...
...Mm? There's some on your hands, too?
Her unfocused eyes turn to my hand. I also got some jam on it without noticing.
Goodness, when did that happen...?
My apologies. Allow me to get it off for you...
In her tipsy state, Saint Louis isn't as reserved as she usually is, and she forcibly grabs me by the wrist.
Groggily, in her uninhibited state, she lowers her head...
And next, I feel something soft, moist and warm sliding over my fingertips.
And here, too...
Mm...
That should do it...
But even after doing all that, she freezes and tightens her grip on my wrist.
Saint Louis slowly raises her head, her eyes wide with shame and embarrassment.
She blushes all the way from her neck up to the tip of her ears.
Wh-what did I just do...?!
She frantically tries to get on her feet, but unintentionally knocks over a bottle of wine that was sitting on the table's corner.
My apologies, Commander! I, uh... I can't believe what I just did!
That was extremely unbecoming of a holy knight... Please, punish me accordingly!
Calm down. You're just a bit tipsy, right?
If you insist on being punished... How about helping me clean up the mess on the table first?
...Yes, Commander! I, Saint Louis, will devote myself to this task!

sequence: The Opulent! The Glamorous! Luxury Bay!  6 Hearts Behind the Water Curtain

scripts.say: I hear U-2501 singing from the other side of the water curtain.
Hum♪ Hum♪ Hummm♪
U-2501, is that you in there?
She freezes upon hearing me, then bashfully backs away.
Huh? Commander?
Oh... S-sorry, I didn't hear you knock...

options.content: Maybe you were too absorbed in your singing?
It's understandable.

scripts.say: I suppose... the sound of running water drowned it out...
Maybe you didn't hear it over the sound of your singing?
It's totally understandable. You tend to lose track of other sounds around you when you're singing.
Um, Commander... W-were you listening to me sing?
After a short pause, U-2501's fingers slip through the water curtain, like she's beckoning me closer.
Her fingertips trace a drawing of a bashful frown on my palm.
Does this mean you're... being shy?
Yes... Ehehe...
Then how about this...?
I draw a smiley face on U-2501's palm.
You have a pretty voice. I'd like to hear you sing more.
Mm... Commander said I... have a nice voice...
I got praised... I'm so happy...
U-2501's eyes curve into a bashful, gentle smile.
Mustering her courage, she pulls my hand closer, beckoning me past the water curtain.
After taking a few breaths, she begins to hum a mellow tune.
She takes my hand and gently presses my open palm against her trembling throat.
I feel the gentle hum of her melody in my pulse, flowing from her heart to mine.
If you'd like... I could sing to you every day...
And it doesn't have to be just songs. I'd let you and no one else hear all the sounds I have to offer...
Just like now...
She slowly guides my hand lower, tracing her collarbone, then having it rest against her chest.
Can you feel it? The way my heart races...
My melody and my racing heart are... in sync now. They make a tune just for you, Commander...
U-2501 switches on a waterproof voice recorder and inserts it between my hand and her chest.
I'll record all of our sounds together...
Your breathing... My humming... And the racing of my heart...
The sounds of running water, our breathing, the racing of our hearts create our own little world...
She simply closes her eyes and rests her chin on my shoulder. Her gentle, pleasant humming continues to flow, just like the water.

sequence: The Opulent! The Glamorous! Luxury Bay!  7 Waterside Canzone

scripts.say: At the end of a hectic day, I relax, leaning against the edge of the pool.
But then, the water's surface breaks, and a familiar face emerges.
Emden emerges right in front of me with a smile, her long hair dripping with water.
I have you now, my darling human... "You have nowhere to run now."
Look at you, all lost in thought... Enjoying some alone time, are you?
"You bad human, leaving Emden unattended."
She watches me bemusedly, her argent hair clinging wetly to her skin.
Before I can even say anything, Emden wraps a willowy arm around my waist and pulls herself closer to me.
Emden? When did you get here?
Heehee... Ever since you entered the pool and became completely defenseless...
"We have been watching you this whole time."
But it won't do to have you spend your time alone... "Emden will decide how you spend your time, human."
With her body pressed against mine, I become keenly aware of the contrast between the cold water and her warmth, and it makes my heart race.
Heehee... My dear human, so unguarded, so vulnerable...
"Deep down, you wish to be teased and dominated by Emden, do you not?"
Hush... You need not answer.
Emden gently touches my lips. With her other hand, she slowly traces her finger down my spine.
Empty your mind and feel the water's flow... "Yes, just like that... Match your breathing with Emden's..."
You can feel the water, yes? But it won't be long... until you forget even that.
Because what will truly envelope you, shield you from all your senses... "Is not the water, but Emden..."
Emden...
Emden is always here for you, be it in the water... "Or somewhere that's much deeper for you..."
Emden's thighs wrap around my legs, sending a sweet tingling sensation down my spine.
"Come, human... Hold your gaze carefully." Gaze carefully upon Emden, who takes your breath away, makes your heart race.
Become intoxicated by me. "And surrender all that you have to Emden."
Emden pulls me closer into a tight embrace, and perhaps owing to her body heat, it feels like the water's temperature is rising.
I can feel the touch of her lips and the warmth of her breath tickling my ear.
You feel warm wrapped in my embrace, do you not, darling human...? "There's nowhere to run now..."
Now, let us get started, then. Let us delve deeper... "Down this path reserved to Emden and you, pitiful human."
Let us hear it... The sound of your heart, racing loud enough to be heard over the sloshing of the water.
"Let us see it... Those eyes of yours, reflecting the water's light, never to look away..."
Emden feels my field of vision, and my consciousness begins to sway under her control.
Come hither, darling human... "Together..."
Let us drown... "Drown for us..."

sequence: The Opulent! The Glamorous! Luxury Bay!  8 Rapture Beneath the Blood Moon

scripts.say: This is a special dream I've prepared for you...
Is it to your liking, my dear Commander?
At Götz's invitation, I try what she calls a full body VR experience.
When I open my eyes, I find myself in a room at a top of skyscraper, facing a glass curtain wall.
On the other side of the glass, I see an alluring figure against the backdrop of a swaying red moon.
Her body presses against the glass, her long tail lazily slapping the glass with a rattling noise.
You seem to be enjoying yourself.
Yes, here we are stripped bare of all obligations, free to nestle together as we please.
With a teasing smile, Götz's tail slips through the glass like it's water, extending toward me.
It extends before me, drawing a circle around my chest before finally wrapping around my wrist.
See... The boundaries between us are already starting to blur...
Why don't you try it too, Commander?
At her words, I reach for the glass, and my fingertips slip through with ease. What should be a hard surface turns out to be soft to the touch.
My fingertips caress Götz's cheek, and she jolts slightly at my touch.
See? You did it, Commander.
Götz moves her body, sliding my fingers from her cheek down to her neck, then further down to the indent of her collarbone.
At the same time, her tail wraps around my waist, pulling us closer together.
While beautiful, this glass barrier is also most annoying...
It allows me to watch you all I please, Commander... And yet it prevents me from tasting you, leaving my cravings unsatisfied...
Götz gets carried away, bringing her arm to this side and pulling my face closer.
The single sheet of glass stands between us clouds over with our breaths.
The lips pressed against it give off a cold yet alluring sensation.
Can't you just cross over to this side?
If you are asking me to break it, Commander, I could do it easily with your permission.
I can tell... Deep down, you're hoping that I do that, don't you?
True to those words, it feels as if the separation of the glass pressing against us becomes even thinner.
And then, Götz flaps her wings hard, her body breaking through the glass. She dives into my arms...
I've got you now... Commander♪
Her willowy legs clamp around me nimbly, holding me firmly along with her tail.
Her wings wrap around us, forming a space with the two of us inside...
My dear Commander♪
Have you decided how to entertain me?
Leaning into the force of our embrace, Götz nuzzles her face against my chest.
She guides my hands along her smooth back, eventually settling over her curvaceous waist.
Each time our skins caress against each other, a faint, trembling sigh escapes my lips.
Yes, just like that...
Do keep going, quench my thirst... ♪
Faint pain shoots from my neck. Her moist tongue presses against it, suckling.
It leaves behind a lustful bite mark, a sign of sweet possession.
I won't stop. Not until I'm satisfied~♡

EN.title: The Mermaid of the Emerald Sea

sequence: The Opulent! The Glamorous! Luxury Bay!  9 The Mermaid of the Emerald Sea

scripts.say: Upon Amagi's invitation, I'm now standing in the display area deep in the aquarium, where I find her swimming elegantly in the tank.
Her pearl gray tail fits the line of her waist perfectly, glinting within the swaying water.
I knew that you could come here for me, Commander.
Behold this stage, only visible in this world of dark waters. Prepared for you.
Amagi leans back lithely, stretching her arm towards me, her tail swishing in the water's embrace.
After finishing an elegant flip, she leans against the glass, holding up her palm to overlap with mine.
Please forget your worldly troubles here... And enjoy this moment with me.
Of course, if you wish it... We could make it a performance for just the two of us.
Her fingertips draw lines of ripples across the glass. She then swims away, her long hair trailing behind her.
I meet up with Amagi, who gets out of the water tank and looks at her tail with a bothered expression. Apparently it soaked up water, making it heavy and unwieldy.
My apologies, I was looking forward to swimming with you, Commander... But I don't think I'll be able to help you get changed like this...
But to make up for it, you can leave everything to me once we're in the water.
Under Amagi's expectant gaze, I change into a wetsuit and join her in the water.
Amagi approaches and wraps her arms around the back of my neck, her fish tail naturally brushing against me.
She then brings her face closer and whispers gently.
Can you feel it, Commander? The water is trying to push us together... Heehee.
It is as if the very stage wishes for us to embrace...
I touch the base of her tail, and while I can tell it's a very well-made fake, I also feel Amagi's warmth.
It's so elaborately made... Almost feels like the real thing.
I made it, knowing you would appreciate it... You can touch it more and feel for yourself how soft it is~
With each flick and sway of her artificial tail, the distance between us shrinks even more.
Commander... Can you hear my heart race?
It's telling you... that I want you closer. I want to feel you more.
Heheheh, how careless. We're still in the water... In that case...
Amagi grabs my hand and presses it against her chest. I feel her warm skin through the thin veil of water, and within it the hastened beat of her heart.
Amagi holds me tighter, wrapping her tail around me, and we slowly sink deeper.
Amagi breathes out, blowing transient bubbles into the water that soar past our touching cheeks and swaying hair.
A small world just for the two of us... Surrounded by bubbles.
Commander... Wouldn't you like to leave more unforgettable marks on this world?
Even in the water, I can feel the softness of her dainty fingers caressing my cheek.
Amagi's lips gently brush against the corner of my mouth. It's a gentle, probing touch, a warmth that complements the water's coldness.
Her lips move to my neck, and each gentle suckle sends waves of pleasure washing over me.
This... is a mermaid's kiss. I will etch myself into your very being, Commander...
With her lips on me, her fingertips trace my shoulders, collar, chest and waist.
Her mermaid tail sways longingly, pulling me closer into her arms.
The moment I touch her delicate scales, she melts into my chest.
Your kiss melts my heart, Commander...
I am helplessly lost in this small world of ours...
Or perhaps its your warmth that's melting me?
Heehee... You need not answer, Commander. I will prove it through actions.
She smiles, plants kisses on the corners of my eyes, and then brings her lips to my ears.
It's all the same. After all... You are everything to me, Commander♥

sequence: The Opulent! The Glamorous! Luxury Bay!  10 The Genie's Game

scripts.say: At Prinz Moritz's invitation, I arrive at the rooftop pool in search of the legendary genie lamp.
Prinz Moritz is reclining on a float in the pool, fiddling with a strange-looking lamp.
Her swimsuit, inlaid with golden chains, shines in the moonlight, accentuating her bare skin against the dark.
Did you find the Lamp already?
Found it? Kihihihi, oh, you misunderstand. I am the genie of the wish-granting lamp, and you have summoned me.
As a reward for freeing me... shall we play a game together?
Kihihihi~ Just to be clear, you're not allowed to say no~
The moment I pass her by, she grabs me by the wrist and pulls me into the water.
She pulls me onto her float and clings to me from behind.
Kihihihihi... Did I scare you?
It's like the excitement of being in love... Do you feel it, Commander?
But, our game is only just beginning...
And to spruce up our time tonight, I switched up the rules a little bit~♪
Well basically... I switched up who makes the wishes and who has to grant them. So tonight, you have to entertain me and grant me my wishes~ Kihihi.
Her hands slide around as she shifts her position, hugging me tightly from the front.
With only the thin, almost transparent fabric of her outfit between us, there's very little separating our skin.
And if you can do that... I'll be all yours♪
Kihihihi... Can you guess what I'm going to wish for?
Oh, yeah, I should tell you.
I have enough wishes to keep you up all night~ Kihihihi♪
Moritz raises her head and our gazes lock as her slender fingers run down my spine.
Well...I could give you a little hint. The secret to granting wishes is to resort to every means possible to make me happy♪
Then... how about this?
I interrupt Moritz and grab her wrists, pinning her down against the float.
The float sways, and Moritz, who had been getting a bit full of herself, is now surprisingly defenseless.
Woah! C-Commander...
Caught off guard, Moritz lets out a little squeal, but contrary to her reaction, she presses against me.
Haah... I didn't think you'd be...
Kihihihi♪ I knew I was right to entrust you to grant my wishes.
After catching her breath, Moritz reverts to her cheeky expression.
The float buckles again beneath the water's splashes, the chains adorning her swimsuit pushing against my skin.
Now then, let's get rid of all these pointless restraints... And simply enjoy each other♡
Moritz shifts her body and reaches for my back, and I instinctively grab on to her chains that keep her accessories from sliding down.
Two clear, clinking sounds ring out almost at the same time. Before I know it, my mouth is completely sealed by her warm lips.
Her kiss is long and wet. Our breaths mingle, and our locked lips only part when we're out of breath.
Don't you open your eyes. Now... Follow me♡
She flips the float over, sending us both sinking into the pool. All the sound and scenery melt away into gentle darkness...

sequence: The Opulent! The Glamorous! Luxury Bay!  11 Night Rendezvous With the Unhulde

scripts.say: Follow the secluded trail to the Garden of Miracles – the Unhulde awaits you, beneath the veil of starlight...
I follow the instructions and slowly make my way down the trail, until –
Under the watchful eyes of the stars, you have arrived at the Unhulde's Garden of Miracles. Welcome, my familiar.
Come hither. Our banquet shall soon begin.
August's presence seems to shine brighter than any star.
Come closer, yes, just like that... Close enough so I become all that you can see.
Allow me to reward you for heeding my summons...
Yes, a spell woven just for you.
August's skirt swirls as she begins a graceful dance, the glow from the surrounding candlelight rippling around her as if drawn to her very being.
There is no music, only the burbling of water from the fountain nearby. Yet even that is enough to create a tranquil, mystical atmosphere.
Everything she does, from her gestures to the enchanting smile on her lips, seems to possess a mystical allure.
This light and shadow, the night breeze blowing by... they are all but a prelude to our ritual.
Burn the scenery that is to come into your memory.
August dances on, but her expression gradually turns into a frown, and her movements slower.
...Not quite as planned, it seems.
This spell requires more mana than I initially envisioned...
My dear familiar, won't you lend me your mana?
Heehee. You are so willing to give me your consent, not even knowing the specifics of what I want...
Then take my hand...
I do as instructed. August's hand is cool to the touch.
...Embrace me.
More, harder...
Your embrace is so warm, so firm...
The more my body warms up, the more mana returns to me...
But alas, this is too time consuming.
Then, what should I do?
There is a much... faster way of transferring power.
Come, my familiar. Are you ready for what comes next?
I'll do as you say, August...
As the blue candlelight flickers, August gently wraps her arms around my neck.
Her breath caresses my face. Her cheeks are faintly flushed.
Before long, a soft and comforting warmth envelopes us.
Match my movements. This is a ritual for just the two of us, something only we can do...
Have you found your rhythm yet? No more trial and error, then. Put your heart into it...
Ahh... Such sweetness... Yet it's still not quite enough...
Just as we're about to part, my hands move on their own, pulling August closer.
If it's not enough, then let me handle the rest.
I forcibly pull her closer, and our performance continues.
It becomes wilder, more turbulent. More intense and thrilling.
And I cannot let go of her until a long, long time has passed.
You're quite the cheeky familiar. However, that is proof...
That my magic spell has successfully enthralled you.
I can hear it. Your racing heart that entices me...
Shall we witness the miracle that lies at the end of this spell, together?
Here and now...

sequence: The Opulent! The Glamorous! Luxury Bay!  12 Dancing Diver

scripts.say: I recline on the artificial lake's beach, enjoying a peaceful afternoon...
When suddenly, I see something swaying inside the water.
Yoohoo, Commander~
I approach, and find Z15 waving at me enthusiastically from inside a gigantic water ball.
She clings to the inside of the ball, dressed in a breezy swimsuit, granting the illusion that she's basking in an aura of sunshine.
Tadah, it's a water ball! With this, we can take a walk together even over the water. Isn't it great?
Z15 opens the waterproof fastener, her grinning face popping out from inside the ball.
Sunbathing all on your own is boring. Hang out with me instead~
Not giving me time to reply, Z15 grabs me by the wrist and pulls me into the ball.
She zips the fastener and motions the water ball so it drifts away from the shore.
That said, the ball does feel cramped with both of us inside.
As such, the two of us have to stand back-to-back. I can feel almost everything about her, from her faint breathing to the warmth of her body heat.
Woah... It's getting hot with you in here, Commander...
It wasn't this steamy when it was just me in here... So weird~
Maybe it's because the sunlight is so intense today.
How about we head back for now and come out to play again when it's cooler?
Hmm... I guess that's reasonable...
Then let's head back... Eep?!
Z15 slips and trips over me with a little yelp.
We both lose balance and tumble down inside the ball –
Which makes the ball totally spin out of control.
The entire world seems to spin around-and-around, until we lay collapsed there, with Z15 sprawled on top of me.
We're plastered together so tightly that we can feel each other's heat through our soaked swimsuits.
Are you okay, Commander?
Staying balanced inside the ball can be pretty hard... Mind giving me a hand?
She manages to stand up, but struggles to remain steady in the ball's slippery surface. She ends up falling over and clinging to me again.
Z15 ends up giving up and just snuggles into my arms.
I'm sorry, Commander... I'm so clumsy I can't stand up no matter how hard I try.
All we can really do now is... Move bit by bit so we can roll the ball back.
Z15 manages to crawl ahead, but rather than move toward the coast, the waves are drifting the ball toward the center of the lake.
Huh? Why are we moving away from the coast?
After all of Z15's "efforts", the ball comes to a stop at the center of the lake.
Uuuu... I'm too tired to keep going, Commander... I can't lift another finger.
The shore's too distant, and there's no one nearby...
All we can do is wait for someone to rescue us...
I just wanted to play around in the water ball, but we ended up like this on accident... I really am unlucky.
Hey, Commander. Until we get rescued...
Why don't we have some fun to kill the time?

sequence: The Opulent! The Glamorous! Luxury Bay!  13 An Eventful Game of Tag

scripts.say: That afternoon, Z14 stands with an blindfold on, clutching the hem of her shirt.
Ugh... Why do I have to be "it"...?
Ahem. We're ready to run, so you can start counting.
Ah, okay... One, two.. Uhm, am I counting too slow? You're not bored, are you?
Oh, we're fine. If anything, having you count slowly is better for us.
Yeah, it gives us more time to run!
Mm... I could hide in the ship's library...
Don't say it out loud, what if she hears you?!
Calming herself with a few deep breaths, Z14 finishes her count and then takes off her blindfold.
Eep?!
The moment she takes off her blindfold, she finds herself eye-to-eye with a few seagulls that had landed next to her.
(When did they...?! Wait, is this...?!)
One intrepid gull draws closer to Z14, with the others quickly following suit. They start circling above her head and squawking restlessly.
Aaaah! Stay away from meeee!
I just heard screaming from the deck! What happened?!
Hey... We're still in the middle of a game, why am I getting a call?
I-I'm surrounded by seagulls, I can't move... Uuuu...!
That's an emergency...! Everyone, forget the game right now, we need to help Z14!
Whoa! Look at all those seagulls! They have the entire area occupied!
Woah... there's so many of them...
And they're used to people, so they'll come back even if we try to scare them away.
*sniff* *sniff*...Hey Z14, what did you have for lunch?
F-fries...?
(I see...)
Is there some way to lure these seagulls away? Maybe a song?
Uh... Maybe some poetry, then? I'm sure Z46 could come up with a sonnet for the seagulls on the spot.
I don't think that's how sonnets work...
But I did read in a book once that you can drive seagulls away by imitating another animal's cry...
Another animal's cry... Eh?! Wait, are you telling me to do it?!
I mean, you're the one they're after...
F-fine... I'll try...
Z14 musters her courage, looks up, then shouts at the seagulls circling over her –
RAWR!!!
Well, that didn't work.
...Maybe we can use our phones' flash? I heard flashes can scare seagulls away.
At least that sounds a bit more plausible...
All right, everyone. Let's get our phones ready to make a huge flash.
Dubbing it Operation Flash, the girls snap a ton of photos of the seagull and eventually manage to rescue Z14 from their feathery clutches.
After that, the game of tag moves from the deck to inside the ship and they play until they tire themselves out. After that, the group leaves the pier, their hearts beating with satisfaction.

sequence: The Opulent! The Glamorous! Luxury Bay!  14 The Sand Sculpting Tournament Begins!

scripts.say: This time we go up against the Royal Navy. Everyone, let's enjoy this tournament!
If we keep up this pace, victory will surely be ours!
On opposite sides of the peaceful beach, the flames of competition burn bright. Both sides are clearly eager to win.
A rule was established beforehand that I was not allowed to participate in the interest of fairness –
And so, all I can do sit by and bask in the sunlight.
Okay, I've taken the castle's structure into consideration and adjusted the water to sand ratio... Alright, I have the next bucket ready! Here you go, everyone!
Careful... Careful... Eek! I-I'm sorry, I messed up again...
Don't worry about it, we can just start over~ We're all making this castle, so no one's expecting to be done in a jiffy.
Once I'm done with the roof here, I'll come help you, Janus!
I'm almost done with the dragon's tail. What next?
Leave the rest to me. We should probably work on the scales a little more...
Good grief. Why must I be reduced to playing these childish games...
Though, I will admit... this dragon does look cool.
Both sides seem fairly evenly-matched, and with the amount of effort and passion being poured in, they naturally draw the attention of passersby.
Everyone... is trying super hard!
Teacher... Sleeping? Tummy is out. You should cover... You might catch a cold.
I'll put... a blanket on Teacher. Nice and warm!
With everyone's efforts, both statues are completed: a solemn castle on one side, and a ferocious dragon on the other.
And now, the showdown reaches its final stage –
All done!
Hmph, to think we finished at the same time. But the Iron Blood's mighty Iron Dragon will not lose to a mere refuge for lambs.
A castle built for peace is much more beautiful than a machine made for war, no?
I suppose we must defer to the lowly animal's judgment to decide the winner... Wait, where is the Commander?
When did this sleeping sand statue get here?
It's made with no technique, and looks altogether unrefined...
But that's definitely the Commander! Its shape and feel are so true to life, my, it looks like it could come alive at any second!
I daresay we cannot hope to compete with this~♪
Hmph, to think the day would come when we agree on something... But who made this sand statue?
Uhm... Well, this is...
All the chattering around me rouses me from my nap. As I strain to sit up, sand falls from my body.
Huh? Is the competition over? Who won?
Hwuh?! The statue just... turned into the Commander!
Oh, I see... That explains the victory.
It seems the Commander wins this time. But what a pity it is to see such a beautiful statue ruined...
...Me? But I never even entered the tournament.
Heheh! Commander, are you ready to receive your reward from me?
In the name of the god of the sea, it is I who should award the Commander!
Owneeeeer~ Let's go somewhere else and make another statue together♪
As everyone argues, I lie back down on the sand.
We make a statue...? Together? For Teacher...?

sequence: The Opulent! The Glamorous! Luxury Bay!  15 Who Will You Pick?

scripts.say: An amusement park at dusk. A golden glow casts over the attractions, with colors of all shades lighting up.
It's in that scenery that we take our commemorative photo.
All right! Photo taken!
...But I took it so quickly, I'm worried a few of us might have had our eyes closed.
Should I take one more, just to be on the safe side?
Of course. Let's take another one.
With Javelin as our cheerful conductor, we take another group photo.
As we all peer at the photo happily, Duisburg stands at my side.
Going along with Javelin's request... Commander, you're so sweet♪
Say... Won't you listen to my request as well?
Hm? What kind of request?
For example... Maybe we could find some time for ourselves and make a secret between just the two of us?
Shared memories are much more special than any photograph, don't you think?
Before I can respond, her companions overhear our conversation and take it upon themselves to join in one after another.
Heheh, that's a pretty interesting idea. Are you interested in "making secrets" with us, Commander?
Why don't we go somewhere higher? Like, say, on the Ferris wheel...
Who knows... Maybe something fun might happen when we're up there, at that thrilling height~♪
Heehee... A Ferris wheel, huh? Not a bad choice.
Enjoying the view alone with the Commander... It'll make for a special memory, for sure♪
Like ripples spreading from a stone skipping across water, the idea quickly spreads among everyone.
All alone with C-Commander... In a small, cramped gondola... Ahhn...!
It feels like the Ferris wheel might break or get stuck mid-way if I get on... but if the Commander is there with me...
Their whispers gradually turn to loud chattering, and before long, everyone is casting expectant glances at the Ferris wheel.
My, it looks like everyone has come to an agreement. However...
scripts.actorName: St. Louis [An Afternoon on the Lido Deck]

scripts.say: One revolution of the Ferris wheel takes a while. So if everyone wants some private time with the Commander...
scripts.actorName: St. Louis [An Afternoon on the Lido Deck]

scripts.say: Some of us would have to wait until tomorrow morning before our turn comes around, no?
scripts.actorName: St. Louis [An Afternoon on the Lido Deck]

scripts.say: St. Louis' words makes silence descend over the scene.
And then, I can feel everyone's eyes fixate on me.
Ya hear that, my dear Commander?
Who... will you pick first?

sequence: The Opulent! The Glamorous! Luxury Bay!  16 Special Filming Plan

scripts.say: Public Area – Spice Market
Mogador, Krasny Kavkaz, do you read?
Loud and clear~
Phew... I'm a little nervous...
Then let's go over the topic of today's special! Our task is to find the Commander hiding in this land rich with spicy aroma!
Feel free to begin whenever you're ready, you two! And keep your broadcast gear on!
You absolutely need it to prove who wins!
Hmm... But there really are so many aromas in the air here...
Cinnamon, cardamom, thyme...
I wonder where the Commander is hiding.
(Breathes in) Aaah... Haaa... Found you, Commander♡
(Breathes in) Me too... It's coming from that direction? Aaah♡
That's the spirit, give it your all!
Mogador picks a route that won't disrupt the others hanging out in town.
Shhh! Someone's approaching from our six... That smell... I wonder who it is...
...They stopped? Turned back half-way?
Then let's keep going...
Are you lookin' for me?!
Startled by Gallant's voice, the two turn around.
Fwee-fwee! You've been avoiding the main road for the last ten minutes, haven't you?
You've been moving between stalls, picking security camera blind spots... Acting very suspicious! Please come with me for questioning!
Oh my... I thought we gave you the slip earlier...
Heheh, I had a police dog distract you two and let it go off on its own so I could follow you two unnoticed!
Now, cooperate with the interrogation! Or else I might have to sound the alarm!
The moment Gallant is about to call for backup, a mysterious, delicate fragrance wafts through the air.
Hai Chou suddenly emerges from under the canopy of a spice shop, carrying an old-styled incense burner.
Hello, Gallant. I prepared a special relaxing fragrance for you, as appreciation for all your hard work patrolling these streets. Would you like to try it?
Hai Chou casually holds up the incense burner to Gallant, who curiously sniffs it...
Woah! It smells real nice!
In the moment Gallant is completely entranced by the aroma, Hai Chou shoots a glance at Mogador and Krasny Kavkaz.
(Go while I have her distracted.)
That was close! Thankfully, our show's special agent made it in time!
Ah! Gallant is coming to... Hurry and hide!
Hmm... It looks empty in there. Should we climb inside and hide there?
Huh? You mean, me too?
Of course.
However, the two of them immediately hit a snag when trying to climb over the fence.
Geez... At least take off that blindfold when you're mounting the fence... *sniff*... this smell...
Ahhh, I smell the Commander!
Huh?
You two... What are you doing?
Commander detected! Everyone, follow Kent to the Commander's side♪

sequence: The Opulent! The Glamorous! Luxury Bay!  17 Shrouded in Steam

scripts.say: In the tourist district is a traditional bathhouse, built with nostalgic architecture.
Fragrant steam laced with exotic spices rises and swirls beneath the stained-glass dome.
Lie down, Commander... Relax and let all the burdens leave you.
Relax your muscles... and let me handle everything.
As instructed, I lie face-down on a smooth rock. The warm, earthy surface is pleasant to the touch.
The tension and soreness that had been building up in my body completely melt away beneath her acupressure massage.
However, this moment of peace is soon cut short by the patter of footsteps from the entrance.
Heehee~♪ Commander, look at you all relaxed over there~
How can I see this and not mess with it a bit?
See, just like this...
Before finishing her words, Baracca sidles up to me, and a different, refreshing aroma fills my nostrils.
Then, her teasing fingertips start tickling my sides.
As my body reflexively curls up to the side, she leans in to whisper into my ear.
What kind of face would you make... if I were to push in on you like this?
Heheh~♪ Just imagining it makes my heart race.
You're not going to stop no matter what I say, huh?
Who knows~? It all depends on how you respond, Commander.
Though if you don't appreciate my services, you can always punish me however you want~
For instance... You could use those hands of yours to make sure that I can't play any more pranks on you~ I wouldn't mind being at your mercy, you know?
Before I answer, I notice the sound of a pen furiously scribbling over paper from the corner of the bathhouse.
Oooh...! This is...
Simply scrumptious!!
The interplay of light and shadow, a chiaroscuro of liberation woven from relaxation and teasing... and oh, Commander's expression – a mix of displeasure and enjoyment...
Oh, mio Dio... Just drawing from the sidelines isn't stimulating enough anymore...
Raffaello puts aside her sketchbook and takes a step closer.
Her eyes are alight with pure interest and a sense of discovery.
If I truly want to pursue the heights of art, I have to be part of it and immerse myself in the beauty...
Commander... Let me join in~
I want to use every one of my five senses to make this a unique, unforgettable experience for you... And for art!
The three of them nuzzle against me at the same time, their gentle fingers drawing closer...
W-wait, hold on, you three...
I do hope you'll enjoy our "deep massage" to the fullest, Commander~
That's right... Just relax, and enjoy it.
You can punish me however you like after this... But for now, I want you to enjoy this thrilling moment...

sequence: The Opulent! The Glamorous! Luxury Bay!  18 Cross Country Race

scripts.say: The contestants race ahead, their tires kicking up clouds of sand.
I sit in the broadcasting booth with Akashi, acting as commentator for the event.
We're coming to you live from the Unlimited Desert Rally, where our contestants are going head-to-head in furious competition!
Today looks to be the most climactic match yet! Why do you think that is, Commander?
That's probably owing to today's fabulous prize, and let me tell you, it's something special!
Courtesy of Akashi's store... An exclusive trip-for-two to the hot springs with yours truly!
Without stopping to think, I read the words straight out of the script. By the time I catch myself, it's already too late.
And I can't shut off the microphone in time either...
It was just a personal hot spring ticket during rehearsal... When did it change?
Hwuh?! I..I don't know! It's got nothing to do with me!
For now, let's just focus on the broadcast! We've got a real dead heat, neck-to-neck race!
I turn my eyes to the broadcast drone, which shows the competitors' zealous racing.
They put my honey up as the prize?! We'll all have to get into gear if we want to win!
A friendly race though this may be, I will not hold back. Victory shall be mine!
All right! I suppose this means we've gotta go all-out, yeah?
Heheh, I already knew about this ahead of time. Helping Akashi out for free paid off!
Hello, everybody! Guam's here to give you an update from the scene♪
Our contestants have crossed the turnaround point and are on their way to the goal on the other side of the lake!
